session_316.speaker: Feng Haoran
session_316.text: I strained the index finger of my right hand at the climbing gym yesterday. The coach said it was a mild deep flexor tendon strain, and it has been cold-compressed and bandaged. Now I want to consult for more professional rehabilitation guidance, as well as how to adjust the follow-up training plan.

session_316.speaker: Feng Haoran's Assistant
session_316.text: It is recommended to apply ice 3-4 times a day for about 15 minutes each time for the first 3 days, and maintain elastic bandaging. The recovery period is initially estimated at 2-4 weeks, during which non-weight-bearing hand stretches can be performed, and starting in the second week, try light weight-bearing training. At the same time, cross-training with swimming and yoga is recommended to maintain physical fitness.

session_316.speaker: Feng Haoran
session_316.text: Could you specifically explain the bodyweight stretching exercises? I plan to try them this weekend, but I'm worried that improper execution might aggravate the injury.

session_316.speaker: Feng Haoran's Assistant
session_316.text: You can do slow finger flexion, extension, spreading and closing, holding each movement for 5 seconds and repeating 10 times. Avoid activities within the painful range. It is recommended to use finger separators to help prevent adjacent fingers from moving in sync. The recovery plan can be incorporated into next week's training log. Should I set up a periodic schedule for you?

session_316.speaker: Feng Haoran
session_316.text: Okay, please help me plan the weekly training focus during the recovery period, especially when I can resume rock climbing.

session_316.speaker: Feng Haoran's Assistant
session_316.text: Week 1: completely rest the finger, only apply ice and do passive stretching; Week 2: start active movement without weight; Week 3: if the pain disappears, you can do light weight gripping (such as a soft ball); Week 4: try simple traversing routes. Remember to assess pain after each training session, and stop immediately if there is redness or swelling. It is recommended to reduce climbing frequency by half in the first 4 weeks, combined with low-impact aerobic exercise to maintain cardiovascular fitness.

session_323.text: I just got the research opportunity for a cross-border REITs project next month. I want to systematically understand the product features, yields, and exchange rate risks of REITs in major markets (U.S., Singapore, Hong Kong), as well as domestic investment channels and valuation methods. session_323.speaker: Feng Haoran's Assistant
session_323.text: OK. The core framework can be divided into four parts: 1) Market comparison: U.S. REITs are mostly equity-oriented, highly liquid but with complex taxes; Singapore REITs are mostly hybrid, with dividend yields around 5-6%; Hong Kong REITs are mainly property holders, with dividends around 4-5%. 2) Currency risk: can be partially hedged naturally through forward contracts or QDII funds. 3) Domestic investment channels: QDII funds (e.g., Southern Dow Jones U.S. REIT), Stock Connect REITs (need to watch quotas), and QFII has high thresholds. 4) Valuation: focus on P/FFO (usually 15-20x), dividend yield, and NAV premium/discount. Current Fed rate cut expectations are favorable for REIT valuations. Which direction would you like to go deeper into?

session_323.speaker: Feng Haoran
session_323.text: First focus on valuation methods and domestic channels, especially the selection criteria and representative product codes for QDII funds, so they can be directly referenced in next week's discussion with colleagues.

session_323.speaker: Feng Haoran's Assistant
session_323.text: Recommended three steps: 1) Screen QDII funds: scale > 500 million yuan, established over 3 years, tracking overseas REIT indices (e.g., MSCI US REIT). Representative products: Southern Dow Jones U.S. Select REIT (160140), GF U.S. Real Estate (000179). 2) Valuation comparison: P/FFO below 15x and dividend yield > 5% qualifies as high quality; also watch for a safety margin with NAV discount > 10%. 3) Risk reminders: QDII has quota limits, and recent exchange-rate fluctuations need to be included in returns. It is recommended to first organize data with Wind or Bloomberg and produce a one-page ToC summary.

session_336.text: Tonight I reviewed CFA Level II Derivatives and did a practice question on how implied volatility affects option prices. Can you help clarify the core logic? Specifically, how do call and put option prices change with implied volatility?

session_336.speaker: Feng Haoran's Assistant
session_336.text: Okay, would you like me to first explain the impact path of implied volatility, or focus on analyzing the variation patterns of the Greek letter Vega?

session_336.speaker: Feng Haoran
session_336.text: Let's first talk about Vega, then combine it with the impact path. I want to thoroughly master it.

session_336.speaker: Feng Haoran's Assistant
session_336.text: Vega measures the impact of a 1% change in implied volatility on option prices. The Vega of both call and put options is positive and equal, and at-the-money options have the largest Vega. Rising implied volatility makes options more expensive, while falling implied volatility makes them cheaper. It is recommended that you understand this in conjunction with Vega = S*N'(d1)*√T in the Black-Scholes formula, and practice sensitivity calculations near at-the-money options.

session_353.text: Based on your experience, you can approach it from three directions: 1) Use the street's depth lines as leading lines, letting the eye naturally converge at 24mm wide angle; 2) Use door frames and window sills as foreground frames to filter out extra pedestrians on both sides; 3) Apply the principle of subtraction, wait for gaps in the crowd to press the shutter, or use the high-pixel advantage of the A7R5 to crop out distracting elements in post-processing.

session_353.speaker: Feng Haoran

The A7R5's 61MP sensor still gives about 26MP even when cropped to half-frame, which is enough for daily sharing and has no impact on clarity.

session_354.speaker: Feng Haoran
session_354.text: Today at the Gecko Climbing Gym's year-end exchange competition, I won the 'Active Newcomer Award', and on my third attempt in the finals, I finally conquered the V3 overhang crux! That moment felt really great.

session_354.text: Awesome! From the preliminaries to the finals, facing the V3 roof with a large span, you fell off twice but were able to adjust your mindset and successfully reached the top on the third attempt. session_354.text: From zero to V3, you have proven that you possess the ability to learn quickly and break through. V4 demands more endurance and dynamic coordination. session_354.text: HRV can reflect autonomic nervous system regulation; a decrease may indicate cardiovascular risk. session_355.text: I shot some Chinese New Year atmosphere photos today; I carefully edited 9 and posted them to the group, but there are still dozens that I'm not satisfied with in terms of color tone and composition. session_355.speaker: Feng Haoran's Assistant
session_355.text: I suggest handling by scene: for backlit riverside shots, use a graduated filter to darken the sky and lift shadows; for the old street, use warm tones (color temperature +1000K) with increased contrast to enhance texture; for portraits at the New Year market, focus on the HSL orange channel to brighten skin tones and reduce green saturation, and use a radial filter to highlight the subject. In Lightroom, you can use the 'Warm Cinematic' preset or save your own set of parameters for batch processing.

session_355.speaker: Feng Haoran
session_355.text: Useful, could you elaborate on HSL color grading? The few candid shots I took today of my sister jumping have dark skin tones.

session_355.speaker: Feng Haoran's Assistant
session_355.text: In HSL, orange brightness +20, saturation -5; red saturation +10, brightness +15; yellow hue shifted toward orange. Combined with curves to brighten the shadows, the skin tone is naturally enhanced. RAW files have high latitude, so exposure compensation can be appropriately increased. When exporting, remember to unify the color space to sRGB.

session_356.text: Tonight at Gecko Climbing Gym, I finally conquered that steep overhang V3—so awesome! I want to ask how to optimize weight shifting and footwork to prepare for going for V4?

session_356.speaker: Feng Haoran's Assistant
session_356.text: Congratulations on topping out! The key to the high-angle V3 is engaging your core and precise foot placement; your center of gravity should shift with your body's lean. Next time, do 3 sets of lock-off exercises first, and keep your hips close to the wall when gripping. V4 requires stronger finger strength - do hangboard training 2-3 times per week, 5 sets of half-crimps each time. After training, stretch your forearms and back, and take protein powder to help recovery. Would you like me to create a specific plan?

session_356.speaker: Feng Haoran
session_356.text: I happened to do 3 sets of hangboard pull-ups today, with obvious pump. How should I arrange recovery and nutrition to fit my morning run and ESG study rhythm?

session_356.speaker: Feng Haoran's Assistant
session_356.text: It is recommended that the morning run the day after climbing be changed to low-heart-rate cardio (heart rate 130-140) to promote lactate metabolism. For nutrition, within 1 hour after training, consume 30g of protein powder + 50g of carbohydrates (such as a banana), and stretch for 10 minutes. Since your schedule is tight, you can place fingerboard training after the morning run to replace one regular upper-body session. For progressing to V4, you also need to strengthen sloping footwork. Next time, bring training shoes and try hooking techniques.

session_356.speaker: Feng Haoran
session_356.text: Got it! Then before the next training session, how exactly should I warm up? Do you have a routine for incline movements?

session_356.speaker: Feng Haoran's Assistant
session_356.text: For steep overhang: dynamic warm-up for 5 minutes (shoulder circles, hip swings), then climb 2 easy routes to activate the core and footwork. Then do 3 progressive overhang simulations: first grab large holds and climb slowly, then try dynamic reaches. Rest for 1 minute between sets. Immediately after training, do forearm eccentric stretches: with palm facing down, use the other hand to pull the fingertips toward your body, holding for 30 seconds per set.

session_361.text: The advantage of shooting on overcast days is the soft, diffuse light, which is suitable for creating a quiet atmosphere. I suggest checking three points: whether the contrast is too flat—you can appropriately lift shadows to preserve details; for color, reduce saturation to around -20 to make the gray tones purer; finally, use a graduated filter to brighten road surfaces or building edges to add visual depth.

session_361.text: Specific shadow parameter suggestions: lighten +30 to +40, while lowering black levels -10 to avoid a hazy image; misty morning fog photos need highlights -50, dehaze +30 to bring out layers, while street photography should remain cool and clear, set dehaze to +10. The core difference between the two: morning fog emphasizes the balance between transparency and mist, street photography emphasizes the sense of structure in bright gray tones.

session_361.speaker: Feng Haoran
session_361.text: I see. What about the contrast? I set street shots to +15. Will that ruin the sense of tranquility?

session_361.speaker: Feng Haoran's Assistant
session_361.text: +15 contrast is moderate for overcast scenes; it won't be too harsh, and it actually enhances the rhythm of building outlines and road depth. If you want it softer, you can switch to an S-curve in the 'tone curve': slightly lift the shadows, slightly compress the highlights, and preserve the midtone range. You could also try a sample to compare which one is closer to the 'weekend tranquility' mood you want.

session_5.text: Sinus arrhythmia is common in young people, but high-intensity exercise such as HIIT requires caution. session_5.text: For the Hubei Guangxu Yuanbao, it is recommended to first soak it in purified water to soften the dirt, then gently brush it with a soft brush. session_13.text: I just acquired a Shunzhi Tongbao copper coin with Manchu script on the reverse. The patina and lettering look good, but I'm not clear about its minting background and variety. Can you tell me about it?

session_13.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_13.text: Based on the description, this should be the Manchu script type among the five Shunzhi types. The Manchu script on the reverse represents the mint, commonly Baoquan, Baoyuan, etc. Could you take a look at the coin inscription details? For example, whether the character tong has a single dot or double dot; that would help determine the specific variety.

session_13.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_13.text: I looked carefully; it has the double-dot tong, and the Manchu script on the reverse left looks like the Baoquan Bureau. Also, what's the current market price for this condition?

session_13.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_13.text: The Baoquan Mint double-dot Tong variety has a moderate surviving quantity; it is common, but good condition is rare. For one like yours with natural patina and clear inscriptions, based on recent transaction prices on Guquan Yuandi, it is about 300-500 yuan. It is recommended to take high-definition photos in daylight for more accurate grading.

session_13.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_13.text: I see, thanks! Compared with other Shunzhi variants, such as plain reverse or star reverse, how valuable is this one as a collectible?

session_13.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_13.text: The Manchu-script type was a product of the standardization of coinage in the late Shunzhi period. It is more standardized than the early plain-back and star-back designs, but slightly less popular among collectors. However, your coin is in good condition, and Shunzhi coins generally have room for appreciation, suitable for long-term holding. Don't clean it with chemical reagents; keep the original patina.

session_18.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_18.text: Thank you for the detailed description. As a mechanical engineer, you should be very sensitive to die marks. An original-luster double-flag coin usually retains sharp ridges on the edge teeth left by the dies during striking, and the patina in the tooth slots is naturally uniform. If it has been washed clean, the edge teeth will look whitish, the ridges will be blunted, and the patina distribution will look unnatural. You can describe the features in the photos in detail, and I will help you analyze them. Also, how are the preparations for the online lecture on February 16 going?

session_18.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_18.text: I suggest focusing on three typical types: Sun Xiaotou, Double Flag coin, and Yuan Xiang coin. For each type, select a controversial patina case as the main thread. First quickly go over the historical background (5 minutes), then explain in detail the edge serration features and patina formation mechanism (15 minutes), and finally use your discussion with Zhao Jianguo about the authenticity of the 'Sun Xiaotou' original-luster coin as an interactive case (10 minutes). session_21.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_21.text: The main issue is the arc radius and the way it connects to the shaft shoulder; I'm worried that curve modeling will be hard to implement in the finite element software.

session_21.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_21.text: It is recommended to first try a radius R of 0.5-1 times the shaft diameter, cut an arc path on the model, and use spline curves for smooth transitions. You can make local modifications on the existing R5 model, refine the mesh in the transition zone, and the solution time will increase by about 10%. session_21.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_21.text: Align the lumbar support point with the 3rd to 5th lumbar vertebrae. When sitting, keep your hips against the backrest and let the lumbar support fit naturally against your lower back. During breaks at your workstation, you can do scapular activation and neck lateral flexion stretches: put your hands behind your back, open your chest and tuck your chin for 5 seconds; tilt your head to the left to feel the stretch on the right side. Repeat 3-5 times in each direction, once every hour.

session_21.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_21.text: Got it, the lumbar support should press against the lumbar spine. After work, besides heat compresses, are there any recommended stretches? Like cat-cow pose?

session_21.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_21.text: It is recommended to do the Cat-Cow pose after work (on all fours, inhale to sink the back and lift the head, exhale to round the back and lower the head, repeat 10 times) and neck lateral flexion (seated, grab above the right ear with the left hand, gently pull the head to the left, hold for 30 seconds, then switch sides). Combined with 2-3 sessions of jogging or gym strength training per week, this can effectively prevent stiffness.

session_21.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_21.text: I just read Zhao Jianguo's notes on copper coins and have some questions about the patina and edge teeth of the Hunan Double Flag. How exactly can natural patina and chemically induced aging be distinguished under a microscope?

session_21.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_21.text: Under a microscope, natural patina shows a uniform oxide layer texture with natural color and soft edge transitions; chemically aged items often show crystalline reflections, stiff coloring, and attached residue with irregular particles or bubbles. In addition, lightly scraping with a fingernail or smelling the object can help with the assessment.

session_21.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_21.text: I see. What are the distribution patterns of the 'straight teeth' and 'olive teeth' on the edges of copper coins across provinces? Which type is mainly found on the Hunan Double Flag coin?

session_21.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_21.text: Straight serrations are mostly seen on early machine-struck coins from Jiangnan, Hubei, and other places, while olive-shaped serrations are common in later productions from Hunan, Sichuan, and other regions. Hunan Double Flag copper coins are mainly olive-serrated, with the serrations slightly wider in the middle and tapering at both ends; however, different varieties (such as star-on-flag and flower-on-flag) also show subtle differences in edge serration details.

session_21.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_21.text: Thanks! So what's the approximate market value of these two varieties, Star-on-Flag and Flower-on-Flag, of the Hunan Double Flag coin? It will help me focus on comparing notes tomorrow.

session_21.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_21.text: Based on surviving quantity and condition: in normal circulated condition, the Star-on-Flag is about 100–300 yuan, while the Flower-on-Flag is slightly rarer, about 200–500 yuan; UNC grade (uncirculated) can reach over 1,000 yuan. It is recommended to make a comprehensive judgment based on grading scores and the naturalness of the patina.

If muscle stiffness is significant, prioritize using a foam roller on the outer thighs and buttocks, avoiding direct pressure on the quadriceps. Also, watch for sharp pain or persistent cramps—those are signs of overfatigue and the workout should be postponed.

session_22.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant

Using a magnifying glass to inspect the reeded edge and lettering details can aid judgment. Avoid over-cleaning, which may affect the patina.

session_24.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_24.text: Your main issues are defensive stance and lateral movement efficiency. I suggest starting with slide steps: feet shoulder-width apart, bend your knees and lower your center of gravity (knees not past your toes), point your toes in the direction of movement when sliding sideways, 30 seconds x 3 sets. session_24.text: During a sliding step, how low should my center of gravity be? I'm 173 cm tall and 75 kg. What targeted movements should I practice?

session_24.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_24.text: Lower your center of gravity until your hips are slightly below knee height, with your back straight. Given your build, I recommend adding lateral resistance band walks (3 sets of 15 steps daily) and single-leg box jumps (10 reps per side × 3 sets) to improve lateral explosive power. On defense, use small shuffle steps instead of crossover steps so you can adjust your center of gravity more quickly.

session_24.text: I've just been studying the varieties of the Northern Song Zhenghe Tongbao. Can you explain the specific differences between the one-cash and two-cash types? Also, does the patina color directly affect authenticity judgment?

session_24.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_24.text: Zhenghe Tongbao Xiaoping coins are about 24-25 mm in diameter, and Zhe'er coins about 28-29 mm, so they can be initially distinguished by size. In terms of varieties, details differ, such as the raised stroke of the seal-script character 'Zheng' and the 'walking' radical of the clerical-script character 'Tong'. As for patina, genuine pieces have naturally formed patina, commonly in colors such as jujube red and mercury patina; counterfeit pieces are often artificially aged with chemicals and the color sits on the surface. It is recommended to use a magnifying glass to check whether the wear at the square hole and the rust on the field are natural.

import pandas as pd
import openpyxl

# Read original data
df = pd.read_excel('temp_raw.xlsx')

df_clean = df.drop_duplicates().fillna(method='ffill')

session_68.text: I just finished listening to the ancient coin appraisal lecture. I'm not very clear about the chemical mechanism of the high-temperature color fixation process after acid-etching antiquing. Can you explain it to me systematically?

session_68.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_68.text: For acid-etching to create an aged finish, first use dilute acid to corrode the metal surface and form a loose layer, then soak it in a sulfur compound solution to produce black silver sulfide or copper sulfide. High-temperature color fixing (about 150-200°C) can accelerate the reaction and make the patina denser, but it destroys the crystal structure of a natural patina. A natural patina forms needle-like or flaky crystals, while an artificial one is often a uniform, directionless collection of fine grains. You can use a 10x magnifying glass to observe the continuity of the patina at the edges. What specific flaw did you find?

session_68.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_68.text: Exactly! I compared it with a counterfeit nickel coin and saw that the patina had accumulated at the edge teeth and looked reddish. You said that thermosetting would destroy the crystal structure — so do these observations count as evidence?

session_68.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_68.text: Yes—artificial patina often has unnatural buildup on the reeded edge and at the bottom of the lettering, and the reddish-brown color usually comes from iron oxide rather than a sulfide layer. I suggest gently wiping with an ether cotton swab; genuine patina will not discolor. Also compare the weight: a genuine nickel coin of the same size weighs about 5 grams, while a counterfeit is often 0.1-0.2 grams lighter due to acid etching. Do you want me to further analyze the comparison diagram you drew?

On genuine pieces, the bottom of the tooth grooves has fine sand-like traces, which can be combined with the patina (natural layering of red and green rust) for an overall judgment. session_102.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_102.text: You mainly care about the correctness of rehabilitation movements, office chair suitability, preparation for your medical visit, and symptom assessment. Among the current movements, cat-cow and wall sit are relatively safe, but supine knee-to-chest and downward dog pose risks for your back injury, so you need to pay attention to range of motion and breathing. session_102.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_102.text: Understood. So what exactly are the risks of the supine knee-to-chest stretch and Downward-Facing Dog pose? What alternative movements should I use? How long should the interval be between massage and stretching after physical therapy?

session_102.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_102.text: Excessive flexion in the lying knee-to-chest stretch may increase disc pressure, and Downward-Facing Dog requires core stability, so during a lower back injury it is easy to compensate and strain. Recommended alternatives: supine bent-knee hip lift (glute bridge) and Child's Pose for relaxation. Wait at least 4 hours after physical therapy before doing stretching to avoid overstimulation. In daily sitting, stand up and move for 2 minutes every 30 minutes to maintain the natural curve of the lower back.

session_102.text: I just imported the ancient coin crawler data into CSV, but the price formats are inconsistent. Some are written as '800-1000', and the condition descriptions also contain mixed numbers. How can I clean this with Pandas?

session_102.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_102.text: Recommend using str.extract to uniformly extract the upper and lower bounds of the price range, then take the median; use regex to separate the numbers in the condition description, establish a mapping from condition to price for normalization; when deduplicating, combine time + seller ID to avoid accidentally deleting valid records.

session_102.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_102.text: How should missing values and outliers be handled? Some price fields are empty, and there are also some obviously absurd high prices.

session_102.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_102.text: For missing values, use fillna to fill with the median of the same condition grade, or mark them as 'pending verification'. For outliers, use the Z-score method; values exceeding 3 standard deviations are marked as suspicious records and manually reviewed or removed.

session_103.text: This afternoon I refactored the proxy pool code of the ancient coin crawler, encapsulated the reading, verification, and rotation logic, added exception catching, and it runs quite smoothly. session_103.text: You want to optimize the stability and efficiency of the proxy pool while also taking anti-crawling evasion into account? session_103.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_103.text: Yes, I'm trying to balance stability and resource utilization. session_103.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_103.text: Proxy pool optimization: It is recommended to use weighted round-robin (assign weights based on historical success rate), change validation to concurrent (using concurrent.futures), and auto-scaling can dynamically increase or decrease based on the available proxy count threshold. Anti-crawling: add a request header rotation library (such as fake_useragent) and static delays (random.uniform(1,3)), and if necessary introduce aiohttp for asynchronous crawling to improve efficiency. For data storage, SQLite is recommended; later, combined with maintenance notes, pandas can be used for simple analysis.

session_112.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_112.text: Last night I sorted out the possible causes and troubleshooting steps for the 3D printer's bottom-edge warping, including insufficient heated bed temperature, excessive first-layer speed, and damp filament. Can you help me check if I missed anything? Also, what are the specific values for the optimal heated bed temperature and first-layer speed?

session_112.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_112.text: Your analysis is spot on. Let me add three points: 1) Unstable ambient temperature can also easily cause warping; it is recommended to print in an enclosed chamber or keep the room temperature around 25°C. 2) For PLA, the heated bed should be 60°C; for ABS, 90–100°C. Keep the first-layer speed at 20–30 mm/s, initial layer height at 0.2–0.3 mm, and the extrusion multiplier can be increased to 110%. Also, if the filament is damp, you can dry it in a drying box at 50–60°C for 4–6 hours. Regarding dedicated glue, Pritt glue sticks or 3D printing-specific glue work, but they need to be applied evenly and not in excess. I suggest leveling the heated bed first and trying the above parameter optimizations.

I suggest you first test with painter's tape and the above parameters; if it still lifts at the edges, then try the glue.

session_117.text: Specific advice: in the first stage, perform core training 3 times a week, choosing 3–4 exercises each session, with 3 sets per exercise and 12–15 reps per set, at an intensity of no pain or only a slight pulling sensation. Normal soreness is generalized muscle soreness, usually appearing 24–48 hours after training and easing with rest. It is recommended that you record your lower back's response after each training session as a reference indicator for the six-month follow-up.

session_122.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_122.text: Your analysis is headed in the right direction. A heated bed temperature that is too low can indeed easily cause bottom warping; I suggest raising it to 55-60 degrees. In addition, ambient temperature fluctuations, a suspended model bottom, or lack of a brim can also cause warping; a cooling fan set too strong can worsen stringing. You can first adjust the temperature parameters and try again. If the problem remains, investigate other factors.

session_124.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_124.text: Yesterday I printed a storage box with PLA, adding rounded corners on the inside, reinforcing ribs on the bottom, raising the heated bed to 65°C, and adding a 10-loop brim, and it succeeded. The surface finish improved a lot. But I still want to confirm whether these parameters are optimal, and does the print need post-processing after completion?

session_124.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_124.text: Your plan is very solid: a 1 mm fillet radius effectively reduces shrinkage stress concentration, the stiffening ribs enhance structural rigidity, a 65°C heated bed provides good adhesion for PLA, and a 10-loop brim is enough to prevent warping. I suggest optimizing the rib dimensions to 0.8 times the wall thickness and distributing them evenly. For post-processing, you can wet-sand with 400–800 grit sandpaper to remove layer lines, then apply acrylic varnish to protect the surface and improve durability.

session_124.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_124.text: Are there any tips for sanding? For example, sanding direction and pressure? Also, are there any eco-friendly, non-toxic varnish options?

session_124.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_124.text: Sanding should be done in one direction along the printing layer lines, with even pressure, to avoid local overheating and softening. It is recommended to use water-soluble acrylic varnish (such as Vallejo or Liquitex), which dries quickly and is non-toxic; brushing on 2-3 coats is enough. Soaking in water for 10 minutes before sanding can reduce dust.

session_124.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_124.text: I just discussed with my father the monthly offset repayment of a Tianjin housing provident fund loan. He listed the ID card, provident fund card, loan contract, and other materials, but that was based on his experience years ago. Now it is 2025, and I want to confirm the latest process and points to note, such as whether it can be handled online, when it takes effect, and the minimum balance required in the account. Tomorrow I plan to call for consultation during my lunch break or check the official website. Could you first help me sort out the key points?

session_124.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_124.text: OK. According to the current policy (2025) of the Tianjin Housing Provident Fund Management Center, monthly offset repayment of the loan can be handled online through the “Tianjin Provident Fund” app or WeChat official account. The required materials are basically the same: ID card, provident fund card, and loan contract. It will take effect the following month after processing, and the account balance must remain at least 1 yuan (there is no minimum retained amount limit). Note: if it is a combined loan, the provident fund loan portion will be offset first, and the remaining amount will then offset the commercial loan; if contributions are suspended or you change employers, you need to actively update the binding information. It is recommended that you call the 12329 customer service hotline or log on to the official website's “Service Guide” section to verify the details.

session_124.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_124.text: If I do it online, do I need to pass a qualification review first? Also, what is the monthly deduction order after I sign up? What happens if the account balance is insufficient?

session_124.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_124.text: Yes, you first need to confirm that the provident fund account status is normal and the loan is not overdue. Deduction order: each month, the provident fund account balance is deducted first, and any shortfall is deducted from the bound repayment bank card. If the account balance is sufficient, no additional funds will be frozen; if the balance is insufficient due to lapsed contributions, the system will deduct the full amount from the bank card, but it will not affect the existing loan offset agreement. It is recommended that you make sure all personal information (such as mobile phone number and bank card) is up to date before processing, so that you don't miss notifications.

session_124.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_124.text: Got it. Also, after the procedure, if I want to repay the loan early, will it affect the monthly offset agreement? And if I change jobs to a new employer, do I need to reapply?

session_124.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_124.text: Early partial repayment does not affect the loan offset agreement, but it requires a separate application. After changing employers, there is no need to reapply; you only need to update the employer information in the housing provident fund system (usually assisted by HR at the new employer), and the agreement will continue automatically. I suggest you confirm during tomorrow's phone consultation whether 'employer changes need to be proactively reported,' to avoid abnormal deductions due to delayed information. You plan to call during tomorrow's lunch break. I suggest preparing a list of questions in advance, such as asking the customer service whether on-site processing is supported and whether electronic copies of required materials can replace the originals.

session_124.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_124.text: I plan to make a succulent flower stand from pine boards and want to use mortise-and-tenon joinery. In the afternoon, I visited Master Qian at the Yangliuqing Woodworking Workshop, and he suggested 45-degree miter joints. In the evening, I read about the corner-leg mortise-and-tenon joint in Wang Shixiang's 'Ming-style Furniture Research', but I'm not sure which mortise-and-tenon joint is more suitable for the thickness and stress of pine boards. Also, Master Qian recommended premium wood wax oil, but I don't know the specific brand, application steps, and sanding grit.

session_124.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_124.text: Pine is relatively soft and prone to deformation. For a lightweight plant stand, a mitered corner tenon or single-shoulder tenon is recommended; a 45-degree mitered joint combined with the mitered corner tenon can improve structural stability. For wood wax oil, use an imported premium product (such as OSMO or Biofa). During application, first sand with 180-grit sandpaper, apply the first coat and let it sit for 8 hours, then lightly sand with 240-grit, apply a second coat, and finally polish with a cotton cloth. The end grain should be sealed with wax to prevent cracking. Succulents are light, so no excessive reinforcement is needed.

session_124.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_124.text: I noticed the pine board is 1.2 meters long and 2 centimeters thick. Does the mitered mortise-and-tenon joint have any requirements for board thickness? Also, does wood wax oil need to be completely dry between two coats?

session_124.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_124.text: 2 cm pine board is suitable for the mitered corner mortise-and-tenon joint, but a tenon depth of about 1 cm needs to be reserved to avoid weakening the structure. Between two coats of wood wax oil, the first coat must dry completely (recommended 8-12 hours), otherwise it will easily peel. You can first test it on a small scrap piece to confirm absorption.

session_126.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant

Example weekly plan: Week 1: run 3 km twice and 4 km once (pace 7 min/km). Week 2: 3/4/5 km. Week 3: progress to 4/5/6 km, and so on. session_131.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_131.text: This morning I ran 8 kilometers. The physical test data shows weight 73kg and body fat 21.3%, which feels a bit high. After looking at the diet records, dinner is always greasy. I want my mother to switch from braising to steaming, but I'm not sure how to adjust the overall diet structure more scientifically.

session_131.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_131.text: Got it. Your body fat percentage of 21.3% is in the normal range (for healthy men, 15-20% is usually excellent, 20-25% is acceptable). Considering that you exercise regularly, optimizing your diet can further improve it. Recommended daily macronutrient reference: carbohydrates 45-55%, protein 25-30%, fat 20-25%. The 30-minute to 1-hour window after running is the supplementation window, where you can consume fast-absorbing protein and carbohydrates.

session_131.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_131.text: For dinner, replace braised fish with steamed fish; for lunch, add stir-fried seasonal vegetables. Is this the right direction? Also, I'd like to use Excel to track trends—how do I match diet and exercise data?

session_131.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_131.text: Yes, steaming reduces about 50-80 kcal per 100 grams compared to red-braising, and also reduces sugar and oil intake. Recommendation: for lunch, ensure one palm-sized portion of protein (such as chicken breast or fish) + one fist-sized portion of staple food (whole grains) + two fists of vegetables; for dinner, similar but with half the staple food. In Excel, you can create two tables: one records daily meals (marking estimated grams of carbs, protein, and fat for each meal), and the other records exercise mileage and heart rate. Summarize weekly to compare trends, focusing on body fat percentage and weight changes.

session_131.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_131.text: Today is Mother's Day. At 8:30 in the morning, I gave my mother a succulent plant stand I made by hand. When she saw the mortise-and-tenon structure, her eyes welled up and she turned away to secretly wipe her tears... Dad was also nearby praising my craftsmanship.

session_131.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_131.text: Your mother's words 'Xuanxuan has grown up' must have warmed your heart, right? The handcrafted gift carried time and care, and the mortise-and-tenon technique in particular required patient craftsmanship—she could feel how much you've grown and how much care you put into it.

session_131.text: Yes, I keep savoring that sentence. Later, when I helped her arrange the clivia and succulents, she kept gently touching the plant stand and saying it was prettier than store-bought ones — that solid feeling made me feel all those late nights doing woodworking were worth it.

session_131.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_131.text: You are usually emotionally reserved but meticulous in what you do. This time you expressed love through actions. What Mom received is not just a gift, but your quiet guardianship. Deep down, you actually long for such family understanding and affirmation, right?

session_132.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_132.text: In the afternoon, Li Xiang and I discussed the finite element analysis plan. The stress concentration in the shaft shoulder transition area needs to be optimized, and we need to present a solution at tomorrow's internal discussion meeting. What common optimization methods do you have?

session_132.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_132.text: Increasing the transition fillet radius or using elliptical/Bézier curve transitions can effectively reduce the stress concentration factor. Also check the material fatigue properties, referring to the recommended fillet values in the Mechanical Design Handbook, generally taking 0.1 to 0.2 times the shaft diameter.

session_132.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_132.text: I initially chose R5 for the fillet radius, but the shaft space is limited, and R8 may interfere with the bearing seat. Would an elliptical transition curve be more suitable?

session_132.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_132.text: The elliptical transition curve can optimize the stress distribution without increasing the radial dimension, but it needs to be modeled separately. I suggest first using R5 for static analysis to compare the stress concentration factor. If the results are not satisfactory, switch to the elliptical transition, while also considering a chamfer with a relief groove. These two sets of comparative data can be presented at tomorrow's discussion meeting.

session_132.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_132.text: I just examined a Republic of China Year 23 Sun Yat-sen sailing ship silver dollar with a bright flashlight and a magnifying glass. I'd like to ask about the key details for authenticating it, such as the shape of the edge reeding, the features of the inner teeth, and the current market conditions.

session_132.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_132.text: For the genuine Republic of China Year 23 Junk dollar, the edge teeth are deep, even, and olive-shaped; the inner teeth are fine, neat, and not stuck together. Standard weight is 26.7 grams, diameter 39.4 mm, and the sound is clear and lingering. Recently, good-condition pieces sell for 1,500-3,000 yuan, and graded coins are even higher. I suggest you pay special attention to whether the edge teeth have a frosted feel or are too shallow—these are common signs of counterfeits.

session_132.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_132.text: I observed that the edge serrations have a slight chamfer and the sound is relatively crisp, matching the features you described. But the patina color is rather dark and bluish. Is this normal?

session_132.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_132.text: The dark blue patina could be due to natural oxidation or environmental factors. Genuine pieces have a naturally transitioning patina without any artificial smeared appearance. It is recommended to use a magnifying glass to check whether the patina has penetrated into the recesses of the coin surface. If it is even and has no pungent odor, it is likely genuine. You can also weigh it to verify, with an error of no more than 0.1 gram.

session_132.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_132.text: It weighs exactly 26.7 grams, and the patina is natural. So what is the current collecting prospect of this silver coin? Should I continue to hold it?

session_132.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_132.text: The Republic of China 23rd Year Boat Dollar has relatively stable short-term gains because of its large mintage and many surviving pieces, but over the long term, circulated varieties still hold their value. It is recommended to focus first on condition and variety; for example, the Central Mint version or the same-face version is rarer. If you plan to trade, you can refer to NGC or PCGS graded prices, with AU50 currently around 2,000-2,500 yuan. When storing it, avoid impacts and put it in a small round box to keep it away from air.

session_157.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_157.text: At the exhibition today, I saw a flexible unit automatically sorting parts. When the gripper picked up irregular parts, my father said the rigidity might be insufficient. How do you think the design could be optimized?

session_157.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_157.text: You can approach it from three aspects: 1) Add static analysis of end-effector stiffness, use ANSYS to verify the gripping force; 2) Use an electro-permanent magnetic chuck instead of a pneumatic gripper to reduce flexibility and improve stability; 3) Introduce a compliance control algorithm to compensate for position deviations.

session_157.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_157.text: How suitable are electro-permanent magnetic chucks for precision machining? Also, can you explain in detail the working principle of piezoelectric ceramic micro-feed achieving nanometer-level displacement?

session_157.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_157.text: Electro-permanent magnetic chucks hold workpieces by magnetic force with no mechanical wear, making them suitable for flat or regularly curved parts; irregular parts require custom magnetic-conductive tooling. Piezoelectric ceramics use the inverse piezoelectric effect: by controlling voltage, they achieve expansion and contraction from micrometer to nanometer scale. They are often used in ultra-precision positioning stages with accuracy up to 10 nm, but their travel range is limited (typically <100 μm) and needs to be amplified with flexure hinges.

session_167.text: I want to make savory zongzi tomorrow, but I’m not familiar with the specific steps and ingredient handling. Could you tell me in detail about the ratio for marinating the lean meat and the wrapping technique?

session_167.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_167.text: Of course. The glutinous rice needs to be soaked for at least 4 hours in advance. For wrapping, I suggest a four-cornered zongzi: overlap two leaves to form a funnel, add the rice first, then the meat, and finally cover with more rice and press down firmly. Tie it tightly with cotton string in a cross pattern. When cooking, bring to a boil over high heat, then turn to low heat and cook for 2-3 hours. It is best to cook sweet and savory zongzi in separate pots, or tie them with different colored strings to tell them apart.

If cooking them in the same pot, you can cook them uniformly for 2.5 hours following the salty zongzi time, and the sweet zongzi will still have a suitable texture. session_184.text: Recovery from an ankle injury usually takes 4-6 weeks. During the acute phase (within 48 hours), apply ice for 15-20 minutes each time, then apply heat to promote circulation. The crutch height should be adjusted so the handle is level with the hip. When walking, move the crutch forward before the injured foot, and keep your weight on the healthy side. It is recommended to elevate the affected limb at night and use an elastic bandage wrapped from the toes upward.

session_185.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_185.text: Your approach is basically reasonable. Within 48–72 hours after the injury, apply ice to reduce swelling; after that, you can alternate ice and heat. General recommendation: after activity during the day, ice for 15 minutes; in the evening while resting, apply heat for 15–20 minutes to promote circulation. However, note: avoid heat while the wound has not healed, and leave at least 1 hour between sessions.

session_185.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_185.text: Understood. So how can we prevent recurrence later? About when can I start rehabilitation training? What should I pay attention to when using crutches?

session_185.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_185.text: Preventing recurrence: during recovery, avoid sudden twisting or excessive weight-bearing, and perform ankle mobility exercises. Rehabilitation training usually begins after swelling has largely subsided and pain has significantly decreased (estimated 1-2 weeks). Start with non-weight-bearing activities such as drawing the alphabet with the ankle, then gradually progress to resistance band exercises. Crutch height: when standing, the top of the crutch should be 2-3 finger-widths from the armpit, with elbows slightly bent; when walking, place the crutches forward first, then step with the injured foot, keeping your center of gravity on the healthy side.

session_185.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_185.text: OK, thank you! I will follow these suggestions for care. Also, are there any particular requirements for the frequency of wound dressing changes and the disinfection method?

session_185.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_185.text: If the wound is covered with a dressing, it is recommended to change the dressing once a day. Use povidone-iodine to disinfect from the center of the wound outward, avoiding back-and-forth rubbing. Keep the dressing dry; if it gets soaked with sweat or water, replace it immediately. Watch for signs of infection, such as redness, swelling, or increased exudate.

session_185.text: Okay. Sweet and sour pork ribs: put ribs in cold water with ginger slices and blanch to remove the gamey smell; stir-fry rock sugar over low heat until amber, then add ribs and stir-fry. Sauce ratio: 2 spoons light soy sauce, 3 spoons vinegar, 1 spoon cooking wine, 1 spoon ketchup. Winter melon and meatball soup: mix ground pork (30% fat, 70% lean) with scallion-ginger water, stirring in one direction until sticky; slice winter melon and add after water boils, cook until translucent, then turn to the lowest heat and poach meatballs; remove once they float. When shopping, choose rib segments, weigh winter melon, and smell the ground pork to make sure it has no fishy smell.

session_186.text: I just tested the formaldehyde in the new house: 0.09 mg/m³ in the master bedroom, and 0.06-0.08 in the other rooms. I want to know what the national standard safe value is, whether my current ventilation, activated carbon, and pothos plants are enough to remove formaldehyde, and whether there are more effective methods.

session_186.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_186.text: According to the GB/T 18883-2022 standard, the formaldehyde limit is 0.08 mg/m³, and the master bedroom already exceeds it. Your current ventilation, activated carbon (replaced with new), and plants (such as pothos and snake plant) help lower it, but their efficiency is limited. It is recommended to focus on the master bedroom. You may consider professional photocatalytic spraying or buying a formaldehyde-removing air purifier (CADR ≥ 200 m³/h), and use a dehumidifier to reduce humidity (humidity < 60% can accelerate release). Linen curtains usually have low formaldehyde risk, but it is recommended to wash them once before hanging.

session_186.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_186.text: Got it. Since the master bedroom exceeds the standard, we need to step up treatment. If I buy an air purifier, do you have any specific models or parameters to recommend? Also, which is more effective, photocatalytic treatment or an air purifier?

session_186.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_186.text: Recommend choosing an air purifier first: it is convenient for continuous operation and suits your ISTJ-style data tracking. Recommended models have a CADR (formaldehyde) of ≥300 m³/h and a filter with an activated carbon + photocatalytic layer (e.g., Xiaomi, IQAir, etc.), and remember to replace the filter regularly. A photocatalyst is suitable for large-area spraying, but it requires professional operation and its effectiveness depends on light. The two can be combined: first use the photocatalyst to treat the pollution source in the master bedroom, then use the purifier for daily maintenance. Currently, you can also buy potassium permanganate-modified activated carbon packs (with higher adsorption efficiency) and place them in the cabinet.

Are there any specific practice methods that can help me quickly master acceptance and continuation?

session_187.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_187.text: It is recommended to play the "three-word story" game: two people take turns each saying one word, and must unconditionally continue it into a complete story. Practice for 10 minutes a day to cultivate a habit of acceptance. In addition, making exaggerated expressions in the mirror (such as surprise, ecstasy) for 30 seconds each can relieve facial stiffness.

session_187.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_187.text: The three-word story sounds practical. What should you do if you get stuck or something unexpected happens during a performance?

session_187.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant

session_188.text: According to the description, it has entered the recovery phase (48 hours after injury). You can start ankle pump exercises (point toes up and down, 10 sets per hour) to promote swelling reduction. Oral ibuprofen should be used with caution; it is recommended to see a doctor and get an X-ray first to rule out fracture or ligament tear. For diet, supplement calcium, vitamin D, and collagen (such as milk, fish, and soy products).

session_188.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_188.text: Figure-eight bandaging method: start from the base of the toes, wrap alternately up and down around the ankle in a figure-eight, and finally secure it on the lower leg. The tightness should not pinch the skin or affect blood circulation. To walk on the ground, the following must be met: no tenderness on pressure, recovery of a sense of stability, and at least 2 weeks later; it is recommended that a doctor evaluate first. Crutches can be used in advance to avoid weight-bearing.

session_190.text: Yes, especially the 'hu' character in the center and the dragon pattern details, and also whether it’s a good time to buy coins with good condition recently.

session_190.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_190.text: Common varieties of the Hubu Da Qing copper coin include the "Guangxu Nian Zao" ten-cash coin, with the four characters "Da Qing Tong Bi" in the beaded circle on the obverse and the character "Hu" in the center; the reverse dragon patterns are divided into water dragons, dry dragons, and so on. The Jiyou year (1909) has a smaller surviving quantity than the Yiyou year (1885), and good-quality pieces are worth 300-800 yuan at market, while poor-quality pieces are 50-150 yuan. The current market is stable and suitable for buying, but beware of sand-cast counterfeits: genuine pieces have natural patina, regular edge serrations, and weigh about 7.5 grams. When you reply, if you mention "Yiyou year," it should be corrected to "Yisi year" (1905); replies from other collectors on the forum need to be cross-verified with auction records.

session_193.text: For design changes, you can first say 'Yes' to accept the current state (for example: yes, the client asked to change the parameters), then 'And' to add a new idea (for example: we can optimize another part at the same time). session_195.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_195.text: My mother is 56 years old and has had a soft tissue injury to her ankle for some time. Every morning from 6:15 to 7:40 I give her a hot compress, apply medication, and wrap it. Today is her 59th birthday, and I want to help her recover with more professional methods. What temperature and duration are most appropriate for the hot compress? Is there a standard for how tight the elastic bandage should be?

session_195.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_195.text: It is recommended to apply heat at 40-45°C for 10-15 minutes each time to avoid burns; the elastic bandage should allow one finger to be inserted—too tight affects circulation, too loose provides no fixation. After the acute phase (48 hours), heat therapy can be used. You are currently in the subacute or chronic phase, so this method is suitable. Topical medications such as Voltaren (diclofenac) have better anti-inflammatory and analgesic effects than safflower oil, and should be avoided on broken skin.

session_195.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_195.text: Thanks! So which rehabilitation exercises can she start next? Her ankle can move slightly now, but it still hurts when walking.

session_195.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_195.text: Two safe exercises are recommended: 1. Ankle pump in bed: lie on your back, slowly flex the toes upward → point them straight, 5 minutes each time, 3-4 sets per day, to promote circulation and prevent stiffness; 2. Seated heel raises: while seated, lift your heels, hold for 5 seconds, then lower, 10 reps per set, 3-5 times per week. Note: if pain worsens during exercise, or if swelling does not subside or subcutaneous bruising appears, seek medical attention to rule out a ligament tear. Additionally, calcium supplementation (milk, soy products) helps bone repair.

session_198.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_198.text: I just acquired a Guangxu Tongbao coin with a subtle 'protruding Bao' feature. My fellow collector, Teacher Zhao, initially judged it to be an off-center error coin. I would like to confirm the authenticity of this variety, how it was formed, and its collectible value, as well as how to preserve it.

session_198.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_198.text: A shifted coin is a mint error caused by die misalignment during striking, characterized by characters or designs deviating from their normal positions. Among Guangxu Tongbao coins, the "protruding Bao" (the top of the Bao character protruding upward) is a common variation, but combined with the shifted feature it is relatively rare. It is recommended to inspect the edge under magnification for file marks and check whether the hole is regular to help judge authenticity. Current market estimates generally range from several hundred to several thousand yuan, depending on condition and degree of shift. For storage, keep a constant temperature (18-25°C), dry conditions (humidity <50%), avoid direct hand contact, and store in soft plastic boxes or dedicated albums.

session_198.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_198.text: Okay. According to what you said, a misaligned coin needs to have an obvious shift to be of high value. This coin of mine has a shift of about 1 millimeter — is that considered significant? Also, if I get it graded, is PCGS or Gongbo more trustworthy?

session_198.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_198.text: A 1-millimeter offset is moderate for an ancient coin; if other features (such as patina and character details) are clear, it can be a plus. It is recommended to first measure the weight (a standard Guangxu Tongbao is about 3-5 grams); if the deviation is too large, be cautious. Among grading companies, Gongbo (mainstream in China) offers good value for money; PCGS is more international but has higher fees and weaker knowledge of domestic varieties. Prioritize sending it to Gongbo; after grading, it helps with price negotiation and anti-counterfeiting.

session_201.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_201.text: Natural patina usually comes with decades of oxidation; the edges fade slightly due to friction, but the transition is soft with no abrupt color-block boundaries. If the color zones are clearly distinct or there is a chemical sheen, be wary of artificial aging. It is recommended to use a magnifying glass to check whether the oxidation layer under fine scratches is continuous—this is the key.

session_212.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_212.text: First determine the nature of the soreness: diffuse dull pain is a normal post-workout response, while sharp pain should alert you to a possible strain. Tonight, apply a cold compress to the shoulders and arms for 15 minutes to reduce inflammation. Tomorrow morning, do dynamic shoulder stretches (such as shoulder circles and pendulum swings). When foam rolling your legs, avoid the knee joints, and roll each area slowly for 1 minute. Increase high-quality protein intake (such as chicken breast and eggs), and ensure 7 hours of sleep before bedtime. If the pain worsens tomorrow morning or local redness and swelling appear, it is recommended to rest for 1–2 days and temporarily pause interval running.

If you already used a foam roller after running, no need to roll again tonight; let the muscles rest. If there is still soreness tomorrow morning, use a tennis ball to press on the tender points in the shoulder and arm for 10 seconds, and breathe deeply to relax.

session_231.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_231.text: IgE tests are usually expressed in kU/L. Common reference values are: <0.35 as negative, 0.35-0.7 as mild, 0.7-3.5 as moderate, and >3.5 as severe. However, the specifics need to be interpreted alongside your symptoms. It is correct that you have currently avoided foods such as shrimp, crab, shellfish, beef, mutton, and chives that can aggravate the condition. I suggest waiting for the test results before avoiding specific allergens accordingly. Take antihistamines as prescribed for 1-2 weeks, and gradually try foods that are not highly allergenic after the rash subsides.

session_231.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_231.text: If the test shows elevated shrimp levels, do I need to avoid them completely for a long time? How long before I can try eating seafood again?

session_231.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_231.text: If shrimp IgE is significantly elevated (>3.5), it is recommended to strictly avoid it for at least 3–6 months. At the same time, oral antihistamines can be used to control symptoms. If episodes recur, you can consult about desensitization therapy. It is recommended to regularly (every six months) recheck IgE levels to assess changes.

session_233.text: After being diagnosed with a lifelong ban on shrimp and sea urchin, how can I identify hidden ingredients through food labels? For example, for common seasonings like soy sauce and oyster sauce, what aliases or derivatives should I be wary of?

session_233.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_233.text: Based on your situation, food labels should be checked carefully: common alternative names for shrimp include “shrimp powder,” “shrimp paste,” and “shrimp extract”; for sea urchin, watch for “sea urchin paste” and “sea urchin roe.” Soy sauce and oyster sauce may contain shrimp juice or oyster juice (oysters are close relatives of sea urchins), so it is recommended to choose pure plant-based brewed soy sauce clearly labeled “contains no shrimp/shellfish.” In addition, the risk of cross-contamination is high, so be alert to warnings such as “may contain crustaceans” or “processed on the same production line.”

session_233.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_233.text: Understood. Do we need to do allergy tests for other seafood in advance? Also, when eating out, are there any safe ordering phrases you'd recommend?

session_233.text: It is recommended that when scheduling a follow-up appointment with the allergist after discharge, you ask about skin prick testing for other crustaceans (such as crab and lobster), as cross-reactivity is possible. Dining-out script: clearly tell the waiter, "I have severe allergies to shrimp and sea urchin. Please make sure all dishes contain no related ingredients and there is no cross-contamination risk." You may also ask to see the ingredient list or choose simple cooking methods such as steaming or blanching. Carry the allergy emergency card and antihistamines prescribed by your doctor.

session_236.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_236.text: Welcome! The CSV cleaning module is based on pandas and csvkit. Its main functions include missing value imputation, data type inference, and encoding detection (chardet). Architecturally, it is divided into three parts: data loading, preprocessing, and validation. For the local development environment, it is recommended to use Python 3.9+, virtualenv for the virtual environment, clone the repository from GitHub, and run `pip install -r requirements-dev.txt`. session_236.speaker: Ye Mingxuan

session_236.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_236.text: Missing value handling supports policy parameter configuration; the default is mean imputation, but users can specify median, mode, or a custom function. PR process: first fork the repository, create a feature branch from the main branch, follow PEP8 and the existing code style, add unit tests (pytest), then submit the PR, and the group owner will review. It is recommended to first look at the contribution guidelines in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

session_242.text: This morning I attended the first badminton team training at the Tiangong University gym, observing the whole session from 08:30 to 09:40. I drew position diagrams in my notebook and recorded each person's forehand clear power habits, footwork rhythm, and reaction speed. I found that two have solid fundamentals and four need to correct their grip. As team captain, how should I design next week's training plan to efficiently correct these form problems while balancing the team's overall progress?

session_242.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_242.text: You need a training plan that is tiered, emphasizes fundamentals, and also takes progress into account. Perhaps you could use the idea of engineering tolerance fits to draw an analogy for movement precision?

session_242.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_242.text: Yes, in mechanical engineering, tolerance fit emphasizes precise matching. I want to apply that way of thinking to correcting the grip movement. But I'm worried that high-intensity correction will slow down the other team members' training pace. How can I design it in layers without affecting the team atmosphere?

session_242.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_242.text: It is recommended to divide the training into a basic group (four people correcting their grip) and an advanced group (two people). After a unified warm-up, do 30 minutes of group practice: the basic group uses slow-motion breakdown and mirror feedback, while the advanced group strengthens the connection between footwork and clears. For the final 15 minutes, mix teams for actual play, using the concept of fit tolerance as a metaphor for movement consistency to avoid frustration from the split. Next week's training time can remain Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday at 8:30 a.m.

session_250.text: I just watched a dovetail joint video and plan to make a flower stand from pine, but I'm not confident about the precision of marking and cutting the joints. Are there any specific techniques or tool recommendations?

session_250.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_250.text: It is recommended to use a marking gauge to mark the angle (usually 1:6 or 1:8). The tenon width should be 1.5 times the wood thickness. Tools recommended: sharp chisels, a backsaw, and an angle gauge. Pine is relatively soft; when cutting tenons, mark the lines first and saw slowly to avoid chipping the edges.

session_250.speaker: Ye Mingxuan

For the flower stand legs, a 4×4 cm cross-section is recommended, with the tenon 3 cm wide and 2.5 cm deep, leaving a 0.5 mm allowance for assembly. Consider the wood grain direction in the design to avoid stress concentration and cracking.

session_251.text: The Yuan Datou from the third year of the Republic of China that I posted: a fellow collector said the patina looks natural but the edge serration is stiff, and suggested retaking high-definition photos. How exactly should the edge serration be examined? What role do olive-shaped teeth and straight teeth play in authenticity identification?

session_251.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_251.text: The edge is key to authenticating machine-struck coins: genuine edges have olive-shaped teeth with deep, even tooth roots formed by the minting process, while straight teeth have sharp edges. Fake edges are often stiff, uneven in depth, or show squeeze marks. I suggest when you retake the photos, use your phone's macro mode, shoot the side edge with side lighting, zoom in 2-3 times, and light it from a 45-degree angle for better clarity.

session_251.speaker: Ye Mingxuan

session_251.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_251.text: Gansu version features: on the front, the characters 'Gansu' are on the shoulder board of Yuan's portrait; on the back, the characters 'One Yuan' are relatively flat, and the edge teeth are mostly straight teeth. In terms of market value, the Gansu version is 30%-50% higher than the ordinary version, and in good condition can reach the thousand-yuan level. I suggest you add close-up photos of the edge teeth and front details of the Gansu version to the forum, and attach your identification basis when replying to collector friends, which can improve the quality of communication.

session_252.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_252.text: Doing light aerobic exercise while you have a cold may help recovery, but the 5 km in the evening is too intense and may add strain to your body. It is recommended to temporarily lower the exercise intensity (e.g., switch to brisk walking or a 3 km jog), and avoid taking a cold shower after running. For diet, continue supplementing vitamin C, and you can also drink Pangdahai tea to soothe your throat. If symptoms worsen (such as fever), stop exercising and consider taking cold medicine.

session_252.text: True, I usually go to the gym weekly plus jog on weekends, now I'm not so sure. Aside from vitamin C, are there other dietary precautions? Do I need to take cold medicine?

session_252.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_252.text: Diet advice: drink more warm water and light porridge, and avoid spicy or irritating foods. Cold medicine such as Compound Paracetamol and Amantadine Hydrochloride can relieve nasal congestion and sore throat, but you should follow the instructions and not take it with excessive vitamin C. If symptoms do not improve by tomorrow or fever develops, stop all exercise immediately and seek medical attention.

session_252.text: Premium Mingqian Longjing is a high-end green tea with a delicate fragrance, very suitable as a Teacher's Day gift, especially for respected elders and superiors. When giving it, it is recommended to include a handwritten thank-you card and schedule a time with the recipient in advance to avoid being abrupt. In the wording, you can express gratitude for their guidance and briefly introduce the characteristics of the tea. The original packaging is usually appropriate enough; no extra ornate decoration is needed.

session_252.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_252.text: Does the packaging need an additional ribbon? What's the best way to store it tonight?

session_252.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_252.text: If the original packaging is simple and elegant, adding a plain ribbon will make it more thoughtful, but it is not necessary. For storage, pre-Qingming Longjing tea needs to be sealed and kept away from light. You can put it in a tea canister or seal the original packaging bag tightly and store it in a cool, dry place. If there is a refrigerator compartment, refrigerate it after sealing for better results. Take it out to return to room temperature before giving it tomorrow.

session_252.text: Do you mainly want to learn about variety identification features, or assess the acquisition value based on market trends? For example, the market difference between the Year 8 'Missing-stroke Zao' variety and the Year 3 'O' version will influence your collecting strategy.

session_252.text: I'd like to know about all of them! Especially the prices of common varieties of the 8-year version, and whether it is suitable to invest in the Sun Yat-sen Small Head coin with five stars below in the current economic situation.

session_252.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_252.text: Eight-year Yuan Datou coins in circulated condition are about 3,000–5,000 yuan, and the notched-die version can reach 10,000 yuan. Sun Xiaotou with the lower five stars is rare, and recent market prices have stayed stable at 15,000–25,000 yuan. It is recommended to prioritize graded coins, pay attention to the coin's patina and the completeness of its edge teeth, and hold long-term to hedge against inflation.

session_253.text: I just created the Python_Toolkit folder and put three subfolders in it: core_functions, auto_cases, and notes. Is it more reasonable to organize the function library by functional module or by frequency of use? Should I add unit tests?

session_253.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_253.text: I suggest organizing by functional modules, which makes maintenance and extension easier. For example, create modules such as excel_utils.py and pdf_utils.py. For unit testing, I recommend introducing pytest and writing tests for key functions to ensure stability. In addition, you can add a config folder to store configurations, and a tests folder for test cases.

session_253.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_253.text: Good idea. For common automation scenarios for mechanical engineers, such as BOM processing and CAD batch export, which ones should I prioritize organizing into the case library?

session_253.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_253.text: I recommend prioritizing these three scenarios: 1) Automatic parsing and comparison of Excel BOMs (you're already doing this); 2) Batch exporting CAD drawings to PDF/DWG (can use pyautocad); 3) Post-processing of simulation results (e.g., reading CSV to generate charts). Arrange them in order of increasing complexity for gradual learning. I suggest using Git for version control to make it easier to track changes.

session_253.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_253.text: I just took photos of the Republic of China Year 3 Yuan Datou and Qianlong Tongbao coins I found on the weekend to record them. I would like to ask about their main variety features and current market reference prices.

session_253.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_253.text: Would you like to know how to distinguish common varieties of Yuan Datou silver dollars (such as the Gansu version and the Tianjin version), as well as the meaning of the Manchu script mint names on the reverse of Qianlong Tongbao and their price ranges? In addition, do you need to learn about key points for grading and authenticity identification?

session_253.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_253.text: Yes, I especially focus on the edge serrations and patina of Yuan Datou silver dollars to judge whether they are in fine condition. Is the Manchu inscription on the back of the Qianlong Tongbao from Baoquan?

session_253.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_253.text: Yuan Datou silver dollars commonly have straight reeding or eagle-dollar reeding. Genuine pieces have uniform pressure. The Gansu version has shallower reeding, while the Tianjin version is finer. A natural and even patina is best. If the condition reaches fine, a Yuan Datou from the third year (of the Republic of China) has a reference price of about 800-1,200 yuan. For Qianlong Tongbao from the Baoquan mint with Manchu script "Baoquan" on the reverse, an ordinary small coin in good condition is about 50-150 yuan. It is recommended to pay attention to weight of 26.6-27 grams and reeding without file marks.

session_253.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_253.text: Okay, I'll go back and check the weight and the edge. Also, what should I pay attention to when storing them?

session_253.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_253.text: When storing, avoid oxidation. Wrap each piece separately in a soft cloth and place it in a moisture-proof box. Do not scrub frequently; preserve the natural patina. Periodically check for corrosion and keep the environment dry.

session_253.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_253.text: The best time to see the red leaves at Panshan is in mid-to-late October; October 11 is recommended as the ideal time to go. For self-driving, the Jinji Expressway is recommended, taking about 1.5 hours to reach the foot of Panshan. The scenic area is open from 8:00 to 17:00, with admission at 78 yuan and a one-way cable car fare of 60 yuan. Seniors are advised to take the cable car up to Guayue Peak and then walk to Yunzhao Temple. Mountain temperatures in autumn range from 10 to 20°C, so bring a jacket. You can book a farm stay in Jizhou in advance, which offers great value.

session_253.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_253.text: It seems one day is enough? Do we need to book a farm stay in advance for one night? Also, my parents have difficulty walking, is there an easier route?

session_253.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_253.text: If the round trip on the same day is too tight, it is more relaxing to stay overnight. You can book a farmstay at the foot of the mountain (about 150 yuan per person), and visit Dule Temple the next day. Elderly people can take the Rensheng Cableway (lower section) directly to Wansong Temple, then walk to the Pagoda Forest to avoid climbing steep slopes. Remember to bring warm clothing and dry provisions.

session_254.text: Today I was mentoring a newcomer and explaining the moment of inertia of a cantilever beam. He couldn't understand it no matter how many times. I tried four different approaches but none worked. I feel a bit frustrated. Are there better teaching techniques?

session_254.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_254.text: You need intuitive ways to explain abstract mechanics concepts (such as moment of inertia), as well as how to adjust the pace of teaching and your own emotions?

session_254.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_254.text: Yes, especially how to break down concepts and use everyday analogies or visualization tools to help him understand quickly.

session_254.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_254.text: It is recommended to use the "rotating broom" analogy for moment of inertia: the broom handle is easy to rotate, but becomes harder to rotate when a heavy object is tied to the end — this corresponds to the influence of cross-sectional shape. Use physical models or 3D cross-section diagrams, explain one key point at a time, and leave 5 minutes for question-confirm-repeat. Emotionally, set a small goal for each teaching session and accept that newcomers need 3-5 sessions to digest.

Hengda said they need to discuss with the chief engineer; Yuanda said they have the technology but would add a mold fee. I need to report early next week. How should I compare these two companies?

session_254.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_254.text: You need to compare from three dimensions: technical risk, cost, and response cycle. Pay special attention to whether the mold cost can be amortized, and the impact of Hengda's negotiation cycle on the project schedule.

session_254.speaker: Ye Mingxuan
session_254.text: Right, the mold cost and lead time are uncertain, and we also need to consider the history of cooperation.

session_254.speaker: Ye Mingxuan's Assistant
session_254.text: It is recommended to compare using a table: technical feasibility (Yuanda has confirmed it), one-time cost (Yuanda's mold cost vs. Hengda's possible zero cost but delay), long-term cooperation (how has Yuanda cooperated in the past; Hengda is a new partnership that needs run-in). When summarizing, highlight the risk ranking.
