session_24.text: Tomorrow the whole family is going back to Quanzhou for the Chinese New Year. Can you help me do a final check on the luggage and itinerary? I still feel a bit unsettled.

session_24.text: No problem, let me sort it out for you. session_24.text: Okay, please make a list for me. Also, the child needs something to keep busy on the way. And do we need to contact the parents in Quanzhou in advance?

session_24.text: Checklist: 1. Documents (ID card, train ticket/keys) 2. Thermal underwear, coat 3. New Year gift boxes, desserts 4. Hearing aid brochure 5. session_28.speaker: Song Yajing
session_28.text: My father is 62. On New Year's Eve, when he was eating at our hometown in Quanzhou, he said his hearing in his left ear had dropped significantly. I used an app to test it, and it showed a decline in high frequencies. I'd like to know: is this age-related hearing loss? How should it be treated?

session_28.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_28.text: High-frequency hearing loss is common in age-related hearing loss and may also be related to long-term noise exposure or chronic disease. An ENT doctor is needed to perform pure-tone audiometry for diagnosis. In terms of treatment, medication has limited effectiveness; hearing aids are currently the most effective intervention, especially for high-frequency loss.

session_28.speaker: Song Yajing
session_28.text: Thank you. I plan to take him to a hospital in Xiamen after the Chinese New Year. How is the ENT department at the First Affiliated Hospital of Xiamen University? Can hearing aids really improve his daily communication?

session_28.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_28.text: The Department of Otorhinolaryngology at the First Affiliated Hospital of Xiamen University is a key specialty in Fujian Province. I suggest scheduling an expert appointment in advance. Hearing aids are highly effective for middle- and high-frequency hearing loss, but they require professional fitting. You can first get a hearing evaluation and try one on before purchasing. There are also national subsidy policies; you can consult the local Disabled Persons' Federation.

session_28.speaker: Song Yajing
session_28.text: Dad is afraid of being a burden to the family and is reluctant to use a hearing aid. How can we convince him?

session_28.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_28.text: You can emphasize that hearing aids can avoid misunderstandings and safety risks caused by not hearing clearly, such as not hearing the doorbell or an alarm. Let him first try a discreet model and start by adapting for short periods. Family members should encourage him more, saying it is for his own convenience, not for others.

session_28.text: After finishing the busy Lunar New Year's Eve, looking at my sleeping daughter and mother, I kept thinking about how my father's hearing was getting worse and couldn't help crying on the balcony. Can you listen to me talk about it?

session_28.text: I can sense how complicated your feelings are tonight—the warmth of reuniting mixed with concern for your father's health. Are you looking to share that sorrow and hope for some comfort and affirmation?

session_28.speaker: Song Yajing
session_28.text: Yes, it's that sense of responsibility and vulnerability. Thinking about how tough he was when he was young, and now... And Xuanxuan's cuteness and my husband's support make me even more afraid of losing this completeness.

session_34.speaker: Song Yajing
session_34.text: I just made a cup with the capsule coffee machine in the shop. The flow was too fast, the crema was thin, and the aroma was weak — the quality was terrible. I've decided to upgrade to a semi-automatic espresso machine plus a professional coffee grinder, but I have no idea about models and prices. Can you help me work out a budget and recommend entry-level models suitable for a small shop's drink corner?

session_34.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_34.text: Understood. Since you're a clothing store owner in Siming District, Xiamen, and your drinks corner is limited in space, you need to balance product quality and cost control. The entry-level budget for a semi-automatic espresso machine plus a grinder is usually 8,000-15,000 yuan. I can recommend models like the Huijia KD-310 or the Oscar semi-automatic, and help you break down machine, consumable, and maintenance costs to avoid impulse spending.

session_34.speaker: Song Yajing
session_34.text: Yes, my husband also reminded me to carefully calculate the investment and not act blindly. Can you talk specifically about model comparison and total cost? Also, after the upgrade, which is more attractive to customers: paid drinks or free samples?

session_34.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_34.text: Recommendation: choose a Huijia KD-310 coffee machine (about 6,000-7,000 yuan) or a Rancilio Silvia (about 5,000 yuan), pair it with a Huijia ZD-17 grinder (about 3,000 yuan), and the total hardware cost is about 8,000-10,000 yuan. Adding consumables for six months (coffee beans, milk, cleaning agents) at about 2,000 yuan, the first-year total investment is about 10,000-15,000 yuan. In terms of operations, it is recommended to offer free drinks initially to enhance customer experience and loyalty, and later introduce low-priced member specialty drinks (e.g., 15 yuan per cup) to gradually recover costs.

session_34.speaker: Song Yajing
session_34.text: After my thorough cleaning today, my lower back is very sore. I applied a Yunnan Baiyao patch and also used a hot compress, but it still feels sore and swollen. What could be the problem?

session_34.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_34.text: Based on the description, it is acute muscle strain, related to bending over to move goods and long periods of cleaning. Applying medicated patches and hot compresses is correct, but note: hot compresses work better after 24 hours; the patch should be removed after 8 hours. Calcium tablets are helpful for prevention, but they do little to relieve acute soreness.

session_34.speaker: Song Yajing
session_34.text: But I have to open the shop tomorrow—will it make it worse? Do I need to see a doctor or get physical therapy?

session_34.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_34.text: If the pain does not keep getting worse and there is no electric-shock-like pain or numbness in the legs, you can put off seeing a doctor for now. For work tomorrow, it is recommended to wear a lumbar support belt, stand up and straighten your back for 2 minutes every half hour, and avoid bending over when lifting heavy objects (keep your knees slightly bent). Apply a hot compress again in the evening. If it still aches after 3 days, it is recommended to go to the hospital for a lumbar spine examination.

session_34.speaker: Song Yajing
session_34.text: Okay, I'll try what you said first. How can I prevent it day to day? I don't usually exercise much.

session_34.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_34.text: It is recommended to do two sets of glute bridges every night (10 reps per set) to strengthen core strength. When working, adjust the height of the cashier counter to avoid prolonged bending. When moving goods, squat down first and push with your legs. Keep taking calcium tablets, but it's best to have your bone density checked at the annual physical.

session_37.text: My father was just diagnosed with moderate-to-severe age-related hearing loss. session_37.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_37.text: I understand your concerns. For moderate to severe hearing loss, behind-the-ear hearing aids are usually recommended. Cost-effective brands such as ReSound and Phonak have mid-range series, with a single unit priced at about 4,000–8,000 yuan. For fitting, you need to bring your hearing report to a professional center, where the fitter will take an ear canal impression and program and fine-tune the device. It is recommended to first have a two-week trial period. In addition, you can ask the local disabled persons’ federation whether there are subsidy policies to ease the financial burden.

Also emphasize that after wearing it he can socialize normally and reduce the risk of falling. Use his favorite opera or news program as an entry point. At present, medical insurance in most regions does not cover hearing aids, but some cities offer subsidies for assistive devices for the disabled. It is recommended to call the Xiamen Disabled Persons' Federation to ask about the specific conditions.

session_40.text: You want to combine flower arrangements to enhance the store's visual appeal while controlling costs and coordinating with the clothing style. session_59.text: My daughter Chen Lexuan is going to start elementary school this year. She falls two months short of the residency requirement for Xiamen Experimental Primary School. session_59.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_59.text: You need the details of the supplementary enrollment and backup plans. Notices for supplementary enrollment are usually released in mid-March; follow the Xiamen Municipal Education Bureau website or WeChat official account. In previous years, there were few supplementary enrollment slots, with an acceptance probability of about 10%-20%. It is recommended that you also prepare application materials for other public primary schools.

session_59.speaker: Song Yajing
session_59.text: The probability of supplementary admission is that low… Then besides Experimental Primary School, what other backup schools are there? Also, do I need to contact the education bureau or the school admissions office in advance?

session_59.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_59.text: As alternatives, you may consider Xiamen No. 2 Experimental Primary School or Siming District Central Primary School, which have relatively more available places. It is not recommended to contact the Education Bureau directly. You can wait for the notice in mid-March, and if you meet the conditions for supplementary admission, proactively contact the admissions office of the Experimental Primary School, explain that your household registration is two months short, and express strong willingness.

session_59.speaker: Song Yajing
session_59.text: I have a bank interview next Monday to apply for a small and micro business loan, and I am preparing the documents. Do corporate bank statements need to be stamped by the bank? Will personal credit affect approval?

session_59.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_59.text: For the corporate bank statement, it is safer to have the bank seal affixed. Personal credit will be included in the assessment, but minor short-term overdue records usually don't matter. During the face-to-face interview, emphasizing operating pressure and repayment sources can help raise the credit limit.

session_59.speaker: Song Yajing
session_59.text: If the bank statement shows one or two months of low income, will I be declined? And what is the approximate interest rate?

session_59.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_59.text: Income fluctuations are normal, as long as the overall situation is stable and can cover the loan repayments. Interest rates on micro and small business loans are generally between 4% and 6%, depending on the bank and your qualifications. It is recommended to prepare purchase receipts and a copy of the business license from the past six months to prove business continuity.

session_63.text: I failed again tonight. The French lemon tart collapsed after baking and was hard, like a cookie. I followed every step in the tutorial correctly, so where exactly is the problem?

session_63.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_63.text: Tart shells collapsing and being too hard are usually related to the butter ratio, over-kneading, or lack of blind baking. In your recipe, what are the exact ratios of butter, sugar, and eggs? What is the baking temperature and time?

session_63.speaker: Song Yajing
session_63.text: The recipe is: 150g cake flour, 60g butter, 50g powdered sugar, 1 egg yolk; bake the tart crust at 170°C for 20 minutes. The filling is lemon juice, sugar, and eggs. Instead of pre-baking the tart crust, I poured the filling straight in and baked it.

session_63.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_63.text: The butter ratio is a bit low; I suggest increasing it to 75g. The tart shell must be blind-baked first (lined with pie weights at 170°C for 15 minutes), and only then bake the filling. The filling can be changed to half whole egg and half egg yolk, and baked at a low temperature of 150°C for 20 minutes. I suggest bringing the failed samples to Master Chen's studio tomorrow for analysis. It usually opens at 9 a.m., so call ahead to make an appointment.

session_63.text: Hello, I recently received a business loan plan sent by Manager Lin from ICBC. I run a clothing store and just finished the spring promotion. I want to add new styles or upgrade the storefront. Could you help me sort out the key points of the plan?

session_63.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_63.text: Okay. The plan usually includes the loan amount (based on store cash flow and turnover, generally 100,000 to 2,000,000 yuan), interest rate (currently about 3.5%-4.5%), term (1-3 years), repayment method (equal principal and interest, or interest first, principal last). It may require a business license, the last 6 months of bank statements, collateral, or a credit guarantee. The approval period is about 3-5 working days, and early repayment is generally not charged.

session_63.speaker: Song Yajing
session_63.text: Which suits my seasonal cash flow better — equal monthly payments of principal and interest, or interest-first with principal due at maturity? And if I only borrow 200,000 yuan to stock new styles, how much would the monthly payment roughly be?

session_63.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_63.text: It is recommended to choose the interest-first, principal-later option: the repayment pressure in the first few months is lower, and it fits your cash-flow turnover after spring. If you borrow 200,000 yuan at an annual interest rate of 4% for a term of 1 year, the interest-first option gives monthly interest of about 667 yuan and the principal is repaid at maturity; the equal-principal-and-interest option gives a monthly payment of about 17,000 yuan. You can first confirm the interest rate and collateral requirements with the manager, and then compare other bank products.

session_66.speaker: Song Yajing
session_66.text: I'm Song Yajing. This morning at 8 I got my physical examination report at Huli Community Hospital: neck and shoulder myofascial strain. The doctor only said to stretch every week and didn't give specific exercises. I own a clothing store and spend long periods every day standing and bending down to arrange clothes. I'd like to ask for a systematic rehabilitation stretching plan.

session_66.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_66.text: For your neck and shoulder strain, I suggest doing 3-5 minutes of systematic stretching every morning and evening, including neck side bends (hold each side for 15 seconds), shoulder circles (8 times forward and backward), and cat-cow (10 spinal movements). During work breaks, do one simple micro-exercise every hour: shoulder shrugs, head turns, and chest opens. Avoid sudden forceful twisting or tilting your head back too far. Would you like me to provide precautions or illustrated links for each move?

session_66.speaker: Song Yajing
session_66.text: Yes, please explain in detail the specific posture and precautions for each movement, preferably with safety tips.

session_66.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_66.text: Neck lateral flexion: Sit up straight, place your left hand gently on the right side of your head, and slowly pull your head to the left until you feel a stretch. Keep breathing naturally and do not shrug your shoulders. Shoulder circles: Move both shoulders in large circles forward and backward at a steady pace. Cat-Cow: On all fours, inhale as you sink your back and lift your head; exhale as you round your back and tuck your chin. Move only within a comfortable range. Do 1-2 sets of these exercises daily. If any movement worsens the pain, stop immediately. You can also keep a fascia ball or tennis ball on hand to roll and relax the tender points along the inner shoulder blades.

session_77.speaker: Song Yajing
session_77.text: I just created a customer group called "Yajing Lifestyle Store Spring Good Clothes" with 30 regular customers, but I'm not sure how to run it to keep it active and encourage in-store purchases. Any suggestions?

session_77.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_77.text: Suggest planning content 3-4 times a week: Monday morning greetings + new product preview, Wednesday outfit sharing or customer styling display, Friday floral updates or exclusive limited-time discounts, and weekends can initiate polls or check-in activities. Avoid hard ads in the early stage; use florals and styling to build trust, and guide customers to the store for try-ons or interactions.

session_77.speaker: Song Yajing
session_77.text: So how do I balance commercial promotion and user experience? I'm afraid that sending too many discounts will turn people off.

session_77.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_77.text: Recommend adopting a '3+1' content ratio: after every 3 pieces of value content (such as styling, floristry, and life sharing), schedule 1 piece of commercial promotion (such as exclusive group discounts and limited-time in-store benefits). Design offers as 'screenshot at the store to claim' or 'book a fitting to enjoy a discount', which can promote consumption without feeling forced.

session_77.speaker: Song Yajing
session_77.text: Got it, I'll try this pace first. What if there's negative feedback in the group?

session_77.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_77.text: For negative feedback, it is recommended to reply privately within 24 hours, empathizing first before solving the problem. For example: 'We are very sorry for the poor experience you had. Could you tell us more specifically what happened?' Avoid arguing in group chats. Treat the issue as an opportunity for improvement, and publicly thank people and share the improvements at an appropriate time.

session_78.speaker: Song Yajing
session_78.text: My daughter Xuanxuan has had a fever on and off today, from 37.6°C in the morning to 38.0°C in the evening. I used physical cooling, but I'm not sure whether she needs medication or when I should take her to the hospital.

session_78.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_78.text: I understand your anxiety. Your daughter has repeated low-grade fever. The key is to assess her mental state and temperature trend. Currently 38.0°C is a low fever; if she is in good spirits, you can continue observing; if it keeps rising or any abnormalities appear, consider medication or seeing a doctor. It is recommended to first confirm the child's condition and specific care details.

session_78.speaker: Song Yajing
session_78.text: She is still in good spirits now; she just whimpers before sleep and says she is thirsty when she wakes up. I wiped her forehead and neck with warm water. Are there other places I should wipe? Is there anything that needs special attention?

session_78.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_78.text: For physical cooling, you can use a warm towel to wipe areas like the armpits and the groin where heat is dissipated, but avoid the chest, abdomen, and soles of the feet. If the temperature is below 38.5°C and the child is in good spirits, no medication is needed. If it exceeds 38.5°C or the child is uncomfortable, you may consider acetaminophen (dose calculated by weight). Watch for warning signs such as rapid breathing, lethargy, and refusal to eat. If any appear, seek medical attention immediately.

session_78.speaker: Song Yajing
session_78.text: Okay, then I'll continue to monitor my temperature. What if it keeps fluctuating but doesn't exceed 38.5°C? Do I need to intervene early?

session_78.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_78.text: Recurrent low-grade fever that does not exceed 38.5°C with good mental state requires no medication intervention. The key is to drink more water, reduce clothing, and keep the air circulating. If it still recurs after more than 72 hours, or if abnormal crying, vomiting, or a rash appears, please seek medical attention promptly. You have done very well; just keep monitoring.

session_81.speaker: Song Yajing
session_81.text: Okay, I'll try semi-recumbent position and a hot compress first. Tomorrow morning I need to attend Mass at 7:30, and I'll go to the community hospital after it opens at 9:30. That should be fine time-wise, right? Can I get rhinitis medication from a general practitioner?

session_81.text: There is plenty of time. The Mass lasts about an hour, so going to the community hospital right after should be just right. session_81.speaker: Song Yajing
session_81.text: Today I saw eco-friendly fabrics at the Xiamen Fashion Show, and I'm especially interested in recycled nylon made from waste fishing nets and plant-dyed organic cotton. Can you explain in detail their technical principles and environmental certifications?

session_81.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_81.text: Okay. Recycled nylon made from discarded fishing nets is produced by cleaning, melting, and re-spinning waste fishing nets. Its performance is close to that of virgin nylon, but carbon emissions are reduced by about 80%. Plant-dyed organic cotton uses natural plant extracts for dyeing and contains no chemical auxiliaries, but note that its colorfastness is relatively low, so cold hand washing or dry cleaning is recommended. Common eco-certifications include GOTS (Global Organic Textile Standard) and GRS (Global Recycled Standard). Some domestic agent channels can already provide fabrics that meet these certifications. Would you like to learn about specific suppliers?

session_81.speaker: Song Yajing
session_81.text: Yes, I'd like to know which reliable agents are available domestically? What is the approximate minimum order quantity? And how much higher is the cost compared to ordinary fabric?

session_81.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_81.text: As for domestic agents, there are several traders in Xiamen specializing in recycled fabrics, such as Lüxian Technology and Huansheng Textiles, which can provide samples. The minimum order quantity is usually 100-500 meters, but small trial orders are negotiable. In terms of cost, recycled nylon is 20-30% higher than ordinary nylon, and plant-dyed organic cotton is 30-50% higher. Considering that you plan to introduce 1-2 new products in autumn, I suggest choosing one signature fabric first, such as recycled nylon bucket hats or plant-dyed scarves, and keeping the first order within 100 pieces. Use the “eco-friendly story” as a marketing selling point, for example, noting that each product is equivalent to recycling 0.5 kilograms of fishing nets. Would you like me to put together a purchasing list and talking points for you?

session_81.speaker: Song Yajing
session_81.text: Tomorrow is Sunday, and I'm going to Gulangyu Catholic Church for Mass. Check the Mass times on March 23, 2025, as well as the ferry schedules and reservation methods.

session_81.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_81.text: The Sunday Mass at Gulangyu Catholic Church is usually held at 8:00 and 10:00. The ferry departs from Xiamen residents' pier (such as the Ferry Pier), with the first departure at 6:30 and intervals of 20 minutes. It is recommended to book tickets in advance via the “Xiamen Ferry” official account. There is currently no notice of pandemic-related capacity limits. It is estimated that the Mass lasts about 1 hour, and the round trip plus ferry takes about 2 hours, leaving the morning time available.

session_81.speaker: Song Yajing
session_81.text: Okay, then after Mass we'll go to the community hospital for the rhinitis. What time does the community hospital's afternoon outpatient clinic open?

session_81.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_81.text: The community hospital generally starts seeing patients at 14:00. It is recommended to arrive after 13:30 to register. session_82.speaker: Song Yajing
session_82.text: I plan to go to the community hospital next week to see about my rhinitis. Besides a nasal irrigator and desloratadine, are there any more effective long-term options? For example, desensitization therapy or traditional Chinese medicine treatment?

session_82.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_82.text: You hope to find a solution that can improve things in the long run, but you're worried that treatment will affect your store's operations and daily religious activities, right?

session_82.speaker: Song Yajing
session_82.text: Yes, I'm tight on time, and I'm also afraid of taking too much leave. And today I drank magnolia flower tea—I don't know if it helped.

session_82.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_82.text: Magnolia flower can relieve some allergic rhinitis symptoms, but the effect varies from person to person. For your pollen allergy, current mainstream options include: desensitization therapy (requires a specialist hospital, course of 2-3 years, costing about 5,000-8,000 yuan per year); TCM acupuncture or herbal treatment based on syndrome differentiation (can be done at a community hospital, 2-3 times a week, more frequent in the early stage); upgraded nasal irrigation (hypertonic saline or supplemented with steroid spray). It is recommended to first go to a community hospital for allergen testing, and choose a plan after a clear diagnosis.

session_82.speaker: Song Yajing
session_82.text: For desensitization treatment at a specialist hospital, I'd have to take leave many times, right? I'm worried it will affect the shop's business.

session_82.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_82.text: During the initial phase of desensitization therapy, it is once a week for the first six months and then once a month afterward, so it really requires a fixed schedule. If time is tight, you may prioritize traditional Chinese medicine treatment combined with an upgraded nasal rinse, which can be done at a community hospital and, in the early stage, can be scheduled according to your availability, with less impact on your business. At the same time, pay attention to reducing cold-natured foods, such as cold drinks and seafood, which may enhance the treatment's effectiveness.

session_83.speaker: Song Yajing
session_83.text: My daughter is 5 years old and wants to make a handmade Mother's Day bouquet for her grandmother. I bought cardstock, crepe paper, and dried flower petals. Are there any simple and heartwarming tutorials you can recommend?

session_83.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_83.text: Suggest making crepe paper carnations paired with a cardstock flower basket: let your daughter tear the crepe paper, crumple it into balls, and glue them into petals; you help cut the calyx, then use cardstock to make the basket wrapping. It takes about 30 minutes and is suitable for parent-child bonding.

session_83.speaker: Song Yajing
session_83.text: Great. Is crumpling crepe paper into balls the right difficulty for a 5-year-old? Also, how can the dried flower petals be used?

session_83.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_83.text: Crumpling paper balls is very suitable for exercising little hand muscles. Dried flower petals can be sprinkled by the child on the bottom of the flower basket or used to decorate the bouquet ribbon, adding fragrance and beauty. After finishing, tie it with a ribbon, write a blessing card, and when giving it to Grandma, let her hand it over personally for a more ceremonial feel.

session_98.text: I just discussed education fund savings with my husband. We want to compare the products from ICBC and CMB, so we can ask questions at the bank meeting this weekend. Can you help me sort out their core differences, advantages, and disadvantages?

session_98.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_98.text: ICBC's education fund has a lower threshold (monthly investment starts at 1,000 yuan), with an annualized return of about 3.2%; you can withdraw part of it midway, but the returns will be affected. With your family's annual income of 300,000 yuan, I suggest investing 2,000-3,000 yuan per month to balance risk and return.

session_98.text: How exactly are China Merchants Bank's tax benefits calculated? If I need money urgently midway, will partial withdrawal from ICBC lose principal?

session_98.text: The China Merchants Bank education fund is tax-deferred: annual contributions up to 12,000 yuan can be deducted before personal income tax, and when withdrawn at retirement or during the child's education period, it is taxed at 3%. For the ICBC portion, partial withdrawals do not reduce the principal, but they will reduce subsequent returns proportionally; it is recommended to keep at least 60% untouched to ensure the compounding effect.

session_102.text: For soreness in the hips and back after yoga, it is recommended to try Child's Pose to relax the lumbar spine, and a supine knee-to-chest stretch to stretch the hips. Hold each pose for 30 seconds with slow breathing. If the soreness is obvious, apply a hot towel for 10 minutes before stretching, which can help relieve lactic acid buildup.

session_102.speaker: Song Yajing
session_102.text: I understand. The sore areas feel a bit tight now. I'm worried that overstretching might cause injury. How can I tell whether it's normal soreness or an injury?

session_102.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_102.text: Normal delayed-onset muscle soreness is symmetrical and diffuse, with a pulling sensation when stretching but no sharp stabbing pain. If there is sharp pain at a specific point or limited movement, it may be a muscle strain. It is recommended to do mild heat therapy first. If it still hurts tomorrow and is asymmetrical, reduce exercise and observe. In addition, tomorrow you can take a walk or do low-intensity yoga to promote recovery.

session_106.text: I just finished a special clearance event today and sold 38 chiffon blouses, but I don’t know how to follow up with these customers after the event so that they’ll be willing to come back and buy again.

session_106.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_106.text: You want to systematically maintain these new and existing customers and increase the repeat purchase rate, right? What specific difficulties are you facing? For example, insufficient customer feedback or not knowing how to design follow-up touchpoints?

session_106.speaker: Song Yajing
session_106.text: Yes, I have order records and group chat consultation data on hand, but I don't know how to use them. For example, should I send thank-you private messages, and how should I combine recommendations to spark interest?

session_106.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_106.text: Suggest doing it in three steps: 1) Tomorrow, send private messages to every customer who made a purchase, attaching 2-3 outfit photos of the chiffon tops and thanking them for their support; 2) Launch a #PostYourOrderGetCoupon# campaign in the customer group, encouraging them to post photos and giving them discount coupons for their next purchase; 3) Use the color-variant styles as a selling point to send staged new-arrival notifications, and build a membership points system to cultivate loyalty. Which step do you think you can try first?

session_106.speaker: Song Yajing
session_106.text: I just finished checking the accounts with my husband. Earlier, color discrepancies in purchased goods caused an inventory backlog. Although we cleared it out at discounted prices, I want to avoid it happening again. Can you give me some cash flow management advice for a small shop, such as how to set aside emergency funds and calculate safety stock?

session_106.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_106.text: I understand your needs. You want to optimize cash flow, prevent inventory risks, and plan family and business funds reasonably. I suggest first establishing an emergency fund covering 3-6 months of operating expenses, separate from family savings. In addition, safety stock days can be calculated based on the past 3 months of sales, for example, weekly average sales × lead time + buffer days. Would you like me to help you break it down into steps?

session_106.speaker: Song Yajing
session_106.text: Yes, how exactly does it work? I'm used to keeping a ledger, but I'm not very familiar with financial planning.

session_106.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_106.text: First use a table to count the monthly sales and delivery lead time over the past three months, calculate the average weekly sales, and set the safety stock as two weeks' sales. For the emergency fund, you can set aside a fixed 10% of monthly income and put it into a separate bank account (such as ICBC demand wealth management). Family and business funds are recommended to be managed in two separate accounts to avoid mixing. In addition, you can consult ICBC about low-risk short-term wealth management products for small and micro merchants to improve returns on idle funds.

session_106.speaker: Song Yajing
session_106.text: Today I stood from 8:15 a.m. to 6:45 p.m. My calves and the soles of my feet are sore. In the evening I did 15 minutes of pre-sleep stretching; it gave me some relief, but I'm not sure if the movements are correct. For clothing store owners like us who stand and bend for long periods, is there a dedicated stretching plan?

session_106.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_106.text: I understand your needs. I recommend focusing on stretching the calf's soleus muscle, the front of the thighs, and the hips to prevent plantar fasciitis. Before bed you can do: calf stretch against the wall for 30 seconds × 3 sets, supine knee-to-chest to relax the lumbar spine, and cat-cow to relieve the spine. During standing breaks, you can rise onto your toes and do calf raises. In daily life, you can also soak your feet and use a foam roller to relax your calves.

session_108.speaker: Song Yajing
session_108.text: Today the doctor said I have hypoglycemia, autonomic nervous system dysfunction, and severe sub-health. What do these terms actually mean? What should I do to recover?

session_108.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_108.text: In simple terms, hypoglycemia is insufficient energy supply to the body, autonomic nervous system dysfunction is imbalance caused by excessive stress, and severe sub-health is physical and mental exhaustion. Suggestions: 1) Carry candy or small snacks with you and have regular meals; 2) Ensure 7-8 hours of sleep every night and reduce staying up late; 3) Take a 15-20 minute walk or stretch every day; 4) First get a complete blood count, endocrine, and electrocardiogram examinations to rule out organic problems. From a traditional Chinese medicine perspective, you can nourish qi and blood, such as red date and goji berry tea.

session_108.speaker: Song Yajing
session_108.text: Then do I need to completely put work aside and rest? The store can't do without me. Also, what are some ways to prevent fainting?

session_108.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_108.text: There is no need to close the shop completely. It is recommended to set 2-3 hours of high-intensity work each day, then take a mandatory 15-minute rest and a 30-minute lunch break. To prevent fainting: if you feel palpitations or cold sweat, sit down immediately, suck on a piece of candy or chocolate, and take deep breaths. For long-term recovery, gradually improve your daily routine, and family members can help share the shop duties.

session_108.speaker: Song Yajing
session_108.text: Today, when I came back from the health center, my husband yelled at me, "You care more about money than your life," saying I work myself to the bone and ignore my health. I was so upset I couldn't speak and could only cry. He slammed the door and went into the bedroom. I feel so sad. I work so hard for the family and the store—why can't I get his support?

session_108.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_108.text: I can feel your hurt and pressure. You've given so much to your family and the store, and that itself is an act of love. Your husband's reproach may look like anger, but underneath it's actually concern for your health; he just expressed it too harshly. Your efforts deserve recognition. Don't negate yourself entirely because of his emotions.

session_108.speaker: Song Yajing
session_108.text: But I really do feel that I might be pushing myself too hard, and I feel a bit guilty. I worry whether the rift between us will grow deeper and deeper; how should we make up?

session_108.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_108.text: Your self-blame shows that you really care about this relationship. I suggest giving yourself some buffer time first. Once both sides' emotions have calmed down, you can take the initiative to express your feelings and original intentions, for example, "I know you're worried about me, but I also need your understanding." At the same time, adjust your work pace a bit and put health first. A warm reconciliation often starts with a small gesture, like preparing a glass of warm water for him tomorrow morning.

session_108.speaker: Song Yajing
session_108.text: I run a store and work 56 hours a week, neglecting my health for a long time. After reflecting tonight, I want to make a systematic health plan, but the previous "mandatory half-day rest each week" was too vague to stick to. Can you help me design a practical plan?

session_108.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_108.text: I understand your needs: you need a phased plan that balances business, family, and health, with details down to daily micro-habits and emergency response strategies. Let's start with the smallest actions, such as five minutes of stretching a day and drinking water regularly, then gradually optimize your work schedule. Is that okay?

session_108.speaker: Song Yajing
session_108.text: Yes, that's right. I'm worried that unexpected work will interrupt rest, and also about how to get my husband and the shop staff to share the load. Please give more specific advice.

session_108.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_108.text: Suggestions: 1) Schedule high-intensity work during the peak energy period from 9 a.m. to noon; 2) Authorize store clerk Xiaomei to handle cashiering and restocking after 4 p.m., and have your husband take over the child's pick-up and drop-off; 3) Take a fixed 20-minute midday rest every day (set an alarm), and replace phone scrolling with mindful eating; 4) Use a "15-minute emergency stretch" as a buffer when unexpected situations arise. These can be piloted for one week starting next Monday.

session_108.speaker: Song Yajing
session_108.text: Tonight my husband and I had a big fight over the fainting incident. Afterwards he silently cooked me some noodles, but we're still giving each other the cold shoulder. I want to take the initiative to repair the relationship, thank him for his concern, and also help him understand how hard it is for me to run a business, but I don't know how to bring it up without seeming abrupt or accusatory. Can you give me some communication advice?

session_108.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_108.text: I suggest you use "I statements" to open the conversation tomorrow over breakfast or while taking your daughter to school together. For example: "The bowl of noodles last night warmed my heart. Thank you. Actually, when I am stressed at work I tend to be irritable, but my family's support is especially important to me." You can also take out the drawing your daughter made and say, "Xuanxuan's drawing made me realize that we all need each other," then propose making every Sunday Family Day and jointly forming a health-support pact. This way you express gratitude and avoid blame, and it can gradually break the cold-war deadlock.

session_111.text: Recommendation: prioritize completing the soft furnishing of the sharing area (keeping 600 yuan is enough). session_111.text: I just finished cleaning the store and announced the community sharing area; regular customers are looking forward to it. I'd like to ask how to divide the functions of the sharing area and how to link it with the WeChat group to keep the momentum going?

session_111.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_111.text: You need specific functional zoning and online-offline integrated strategies. I suggest planning it in three areas: on the left, use the metal grid rack to hang new outfit combinations as a fitting guidance area; in the middle, place a rattan basket with cushions as a customer conversation corner; on the right, put vases and activity props as a small event area. For the WeChat group, you can design a check-in and photo-posting campaign where sharing to Moments earns a discount, and weekend handicraft classes can be registered in advance in the group.

session_111.speaker: Song Yajing
session_111.text: This approach is good! I bought two white metal grid racks and a wicker basket, and I have vases too. How exactly should I arrange them and use the materials to enhance the cozy feeling?

session_111.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_111.text: Place one grid rack against the wall, hang new clothing on it, and attach a label saying 'Try on and take a photo to get a small flower'; place the other horizontally as a partition, with woven rattan baskets on it holding small potted plants. Put fresh flowers in a transparent vase on the table in the social corner, and lay linen cushions on the floor beside the rattan baskets. Place the grid rack partition in the corner cleared out after cleaning to guide customers smoothly from the fitting area to the social area. It is recommended to first DM the active customer Vivian as one of the first experience participants, and emphasize the 'check in and get a flower' activity in the group preview.

I suggest you pay particular attention to minor illness coverage and the premium-to-coverage ratio. After the physical exam in early May, you can compare plans based on the report.

session_116.speaker: Song Yajing
session_116.text: This evening, while cutting fruit in the kitchen, I overheard my daughter telling her dad, "That day when Mommy fell to the ground, I was so scared—I was afraid Mommy would die." I burst into tears on the spot, feeling both guilty and heartbroken, thinking that my illness had made her worry and be afraid.

session_116.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_116.text: Hearing your daughter say that must have made you both heartbroken and touched. It shows how much your child cares about you, and it makes you realize how important your health is to your family. You are already working hard to recover, and you even made a warm dinner tonight—these are all acts of love.

session_116.speaker: Song Yajing
session_116.text: Right, I have made up my mind never to let her worry again. But the guilt is still there, and I don't know how to fully process it.

session_116.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_116.text: Guilt is a natural reaction of a mother's love, but you do not need to blame yourself excessively. You can talk with Xuanxuan about happy things before bed every day, or do some relaxing activities together, gradually building a sense of security. You are already proving your love through your actions, and your child will feel it.

session_116.speaker: Song Yajing
session_116.text: My daughter is 5 years old. Earlier, I fainted in front of her due to allergies and low blood sugar. She is especially afraid that I will die. How should I explain questions like 'Why did Mommy faint?' and 'Will Mommy always be healthy?' to her?

session_116.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_116.text: You want to eliminate your daughter's fear without bringing her new anxiety. It is suggested to explain fainting with a simple metaphor (such as 'Mommy's body occasionally runs out of battery, it just needs recharging'), and emphasize that you have been actively treating and preventing it, while also helping her rebuild a sense of security through picture books and role-playing games.

session_116.speaker: Song Yajing
session_116.text: Yes, she is lively but sensitive, and lately she always watches my expression. Can you specifically recommend some picture books or daily interaction methods?

session_116.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_116.text: Recommended picture books “Mom Is Sick” and “It's Okay to Be Afraid”. Play the ‘Health Detective’ game daily (let her pretend to be a doctor to examine you and ‘take care of’ you), and have a fixed ‘security conversation’ before bed every night: say one thing she did today that made you happy, and promise her you will take good care of yourself.

session_116.speaker: Song Yajing
session_116.text: Thank you! I'll try the bedtime conversation and picture books. She also asked, "Will Mom be healthy forever?" How should I answer so she doesn't worry?

session_116.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_116.text: Honest but soft: say, "Everyone gets sick sometimes, but Mommy will see a doctor and rest well, and with your and Daddy's love, I'll get better soon." Avoid saying "I'll never get sick"; instead stress, "Mommy will work hard to stay healthy because I want to be with you for a long, long time."

session_116.speaker: Song Yajing
session_116.text: I just came up with a One-Week Outfit Challenge community activity plan. It has seven themes, photo rules, and a reward mechanism, and it launches next week. I'd like you to help me assess its feasibility from an operations perspective. The target customers are young white-collar women. What potential problems do you think there are?

session_116.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_116.text: Understood. You want to optimize the event details to increase participation. Could you first tell me the specific rewards? Also, do the photo rules require customers to pair items with branded products from the store? That would affect the participation threshold.

session_116.speaker: Song Yajing
session_116.text: The rewards are coupons and small gifts, so the cost is manageable. For photos, participants only need to show their daily outfits; there is no requirement to tag products. I'm worried that the theme isn't attractive enough, whether the rules are too complicated, and how we should promote it to get customers to participate?

session_116.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_116.text: It is recommended to sort the themes by popularity: first launch 'My Favorite White Shirt' and 'The Many Possibilities of Dresses.' These two categories have broad customer inventory and are easy to interact with. Simplify the rules to two steps: just post a photo and add a tag. For promotion, warm up in batches in the WeChat Work customer group three days in advance, and let customers vote on the order of the themes to strengthen their sense of ownership.

session_116.speaker: Song Yajing
session_116.text: Voting to choose a theme can indeed drive participation, but will it make clients feel it's cumbersome? Also, the preheating time is on Monday, voting results come out Wednesday, and the challenge starts Thursday—is such a tight schedule reasonable?

session_116.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_116.text: Voting only requires clicking to choose, which is lightweight and builds anticipation. Announce the activity outline on Monday as a warm-up, send the vote on Tuesday evening, announce the results on Wednesday and remind everyone to prepare, and start the challenge on Thursday. This warms things up without taking up too much customer time, while also leveraging the weekend photo-sharing peak to boost reach.

session_117.text: I recently read "Allergies and Diet", focusing on the effects of red yeast rice and fermented foods on allergies. I take loratadine every day and rinse my nose with saline, but I want to reduce the frequency of attacks through dietary adjustments. Do red yeast rice (commonly used in Minnan cuisine) and fermented foods like homemade bread and yogurt actually aggravate or relieve allergies?

session_117.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_117.text: You would like to understand the specific effects of red yeast rice and fermented foods on the immune system, and you hope to get actionable dietary adjustment advice to manage allergies, right?

session_117.speaker: Song Yajing
session_117.text: Yes, it would be best to have a specific food list and alternatives, such as which fermented foods are good for the gut, which to avoid, and how to combine them with daily meals.

session_117.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_117.text: It is recommended that you first keep a two-week food diary, recording the association between each meal and allergy symptoms. In daily life, you can increase probiotic-rich fermented foods (such as kefir, kimchi) to regulate gut flora; red yeast rice contains statin-like substances but may release histamine, so it is recommended to start with a small amount to test. Also eat more Omega-3 sources (salmon, flaxseed) to fight inflammation, and reduce high-histamine foods (aged cheese, cured meat, alcohol).

session_121.speaker: Song Yajing
session_121.text: Today, for the first time, I tried handing the store completely over to Xiaomei and gave remote guidance all day. In the end, sales reached 80% of a normal day, but I still feel uncertain. How can I systematically train her to be independent? How much authority can I safely delegate?

session_121.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_121.text: You want to establish a phased training plan, while clarifying authorization boundaries and risk control points? For example, start with the weaknesses Xiaomei showed today (such as bargaining, system operations) to develop an SOP?

session_121.speaker: Song Yajing
session_121.text: Yes, I especially want to know how to set clear authorization boundaries, contingency plans for complex situations (such as major customer complaints or system failures), and how to help her keep improving through review.

session_121.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_121.text: Suggestions: 1. Write three types of SOPs (basic operations, exception handling, promotion strategies), and add today's case to the documentation; 2. Establish three levels of authorization: full authority (daily matters), execute after approval (discounts over 20% off), and emergency calls (system/customer complaints); 3. Have a 15-minute review once a week, using the structure of 'highlights + improvement points + one action'.

session_121.speaker: Song Yajing
session_121.text: The idea of an SOP and three levels of authorization is very practical. Can you give an example of that review structure? For instance, Xiao Mei's performance today.

session_121.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_121.text: Example: Highlight — she used a free gift to close the deal with a bargaining customer at 10% off, preserving profit; improvement point — for inventory inquiries, she can first check the system inventory sheet and then confirm by phone; action — teach her tomorrow to use the inventory filter shortcut keys. This both affirms progress and points out a concrete learning path.

session_121.speaker: Song Yajing
session_121.text: I plan to have a physical exam in two weeks. I haven't had a systematic check-up in nearly three years. I'm a 32-year-old woman, busy with work and under a lot of stress, with no family medical history. Which items should I prioritize?

session_121.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_121.text: It is recommended to add breast ultrasound, thyroid function, cervical TCT, and HPV testing to the basic package. Pay special attention to the thyroid and breasts, as work fatigue and stress may affect them.

session_121.speaker: Song Yajing
session_121.text: Okay, what should I pay attention to regarding diet and daily routine during the week before the physical exam? Can I drink water on the day? Is it appropriate to do physical therapy after the exam?

session_121.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_121.text: Keep a light diet three days before the physical exam, avoiding greasy and high-protein foods; fast after 8 p.m. the night before, though a small amount of plain water is allowed; ensure adequate sleep and stay relaxed. After the exam, gentle physiotherapy such as tuina is fine, but it is recommended to rest for half a day first.

session_121.speaker: Song Yajing
session_121.text: Today is a special day for me—I handed over full responsibility for the shop on the May Day promotion day to Xiao Mei and supported remotely from home. The whole process was tense and exciting, and I want to talk to you about it.

session_121.text: You mean the first time completely letting go and letting the store clerk operate independently. For someone like you who likes to do everything yourself, this is a step beyond your comfort zone. I can feel your unease, but taking this step itself is remarkable—it requires great courage and trust.

session_121.speaker: Song Yajing
session_121.text: Right, she called three times for help—bargaining, inventory, and system lag. Each time I almost wanted to rush back to the store, but I held myself back. When I reconciled the accounts at night, the revenue was pretty good, so I praised her and sent a red packet. This outcome put my mind at ease, but I didn't tell anyone the details of my struggle during the process.

Next time, you can agree on decision-making boundaries with her in advance, such as the bargaining range and emergency procedures, so you'll feel more at ease when working remotely. However, you can drink no more than 100ml of plain water, either to take medication or to fill your bladder for the ultrasound. Wearing sports shoes is good, as it makes moving around easy, and avoid wearing jumpsuits or dresses so that blood draws and ultrasound exams can be done easily.

session_125.text: I mainly want to understand the core terms such as pre-existing conditions, waiting period, and claim conditions, and also whether I should proactively disclose a few minor abnormalities in my end-of-April health checkup report.

session_125.text: It is recommended that you bring your ID card, business license, bank statements, proof of income, and medical examination report. Regarding the terms, focus on the coverage for mild, moderate, and severe conditions, the waiting period (usually 90–180 days), and the claim conditions (payout upon diagnosis or upon reaching a specific state). If the physical exam shows any abnormalities, you can proactively disclose them; Manager Lin will help determine whether they need to be declared truthfully.

session_125.text: Got it, so tomorrow I'll first bring up the abnormal physical exam results on my own. Is there anything else I need to pay special attention to?

session_125.text: I suggest you list the core differences among the three products (premium, sum insured, and covered diseases) and ask clearly about the possible underwriting outcomes in person, such as postponement, extra premium, or exclusion. session_125.text: Hello, I am the owner of a women's clothing store on Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street. After the April promotion, foot traffic declined, and I am currently stocking up on summer new arrivals. My husband suggested that I make short outfit videos on Douyin, but I have no experience. I'd like to understand the feasibility. What equipment do I need? How should I plan the content?

session_125.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_125.text: I understand your needs. Douyin short videos are very effective for driving traffic to a clothing store. At first, a phone plus an editing app (such as CapCut) is enough. For content, I suggest starting with 'one garment, multiple looks' and 'restyling old clothes', combined with your store's summer clothing and the upcoming 'old clothes, new life' salon to build anticipation. Post one video a day and guide users to visit the store for try-ons or join the community.

session_125.speaker: Song Yajing
session_125.text: Sounds good, but I'm worried that I won't know how to shoot and the result will be bad. Will it be a waste of time?

session_125.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_125.text: Don't worry. You can start by imitating the viral videos of similar local clothing boutiques, shooting in landscape mode on your phone to highlight clothing details and the styling process. After posting, test for a week, observe views and in-store conversion, then adjust your content topics. If the results are poor, consider light paid promotion (a few dozen yuan per day), and at the same time forward the videos to private-domain communities to coordinate with offline sales.

session_126.speaker: Song Yajing
session_126.text: I just signed a critical illness insurance policy that includes mild breast hyperplasia coverage. I'd like to ask, are the specific claims conditions strict? Also, I only have screenshots of the abnormal indicators from my previous physical exam report; I haven't received the full report yet. How should I submit them so it won't affect underwriting?

session_126.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_126.text: Mild breast hyperplasia generally requires a pathology report confirming a benign lesion and meeting the contract definition, usually satisfying criteria such as BI-RADS classification or nodule size. It is recommended that you contact the examination institution as soon as possible to obtain the full report and upload the electronic version in PDF format; if time is tight, you can first submit the existing screenshots and explain the situation, and the insurance company may require a supplementary re-examination. The underwriting cycle is usually 3-7 working days; submission before May 12 is sufficient.

session_126.speaker: Song Yajing
session_126.text: Okay, so if a breast nodule is later found to have become more serious, will this minor illness coverage still be effective? And do I need to go for a follow-up examination myself?

session_126.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_126.text: Minor illness coverage only applies to specific stages stipulated in the contract (such as breast hyperplasia). If it later develops into a nodule or a more serious condition, it may not be covered under this policy. It is recommended that you do not proactively have follow-up examinations during the waiting period after applying for the policy, so as to avoid new abnormalities affecting underwriting. You can arrange a physical examination after the policy has been in effect for the full waiting period (usually 90 days). When existing screenshots are sufficient for underwriting, additional examinations are generally not required.

session_132.speaker: Song Yajing
session_132.text: Today I was diagnosed with mild breast hyperplasia. The doctor advised me to adjust my mood, but I'm still worried it might get worse. Could you help me work out a complete health management plan?

session_132.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_132.text: I understand your concerns. Breast hyperplasia is mostly benign and closely related to emotional stress. It is recommended to start from three aspects: 1) Diet: refer to the doctor's 'traffic light list', reduce high-fat foods and caffeine; 2) Exercise: brisk walking or yoga 3-5 times a week to relieve stress; 3) Self-examination: do a breast self-exam 7-10 days after each menstrual period ends, noting any lumps or nipple discharge. In addition, consider traditional Chinese medicine to soothe the liver and regulate qi, such as Chaihu Shugan San, but it requires professional syndrome differentiation.

session_132.speaker: Song Yajing
session_132.text: What exactly does the self-check involve? What conditions are needed for traditional Chinese medicine treatment?

session_132.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_132.text: Self-check method: stand in front of a mirror and observe the appearance; with fingers together, touch the entire breast and armpit in a circular motion, pressing down to the ribs. Compare with last month. For Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) treatment, it is recommended to find a licensed TCM practitioner who can prescribe herbal formulas or acupuncture based on your constitution (possibly liver qi stagnation), along with emotional management such as meditation and journaling. Extra vitamins are not needed unless you are deficient in selenium or vitamin E; you can consult a doctor.

session_132.speaker: Song Yajing
session_132.text: After today's check-up, the doctor said it was caused by 'poor emotional state'. My sister and husband both want me to go back to Quanzhou to recuperate. But I feel so choked up inside—afraid that I'm too fragile, and afraid of becoming a burden to my family.

session_132.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_132.text: It sounds like today you went from feeling tense to being cared for, but at the same time you felt confused and guilty about the label ‘emotional suppression is the cause of illness.’ You want to confirm that your feelings are normal, right?

session_132.speaker: Song Yajing
session_132.text: Right... I'm usually the one taking care of others, but this time I'd be troubling them. Should I really go back? Could it just be escaping?

session_132.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_132.text: Your reaction is completely normal. Needing support after suppressing emotions for a long time is not weakness. Your family's proactive proposal of a recovery plan shows they love you and understand you. Accepting help is a form of courage — you deserve to be taken care of. Going back to Quanzhou to walk with your parents and eat your mother's cooking is exactly the right way to heal yourself.

session_132.speaker: Song Yajing
session_132.text: I just drafted a one-month health plan under the guidance of Doctor Wang at the community health station: 6,000 steps a day, multigrain porridge, giving up milk tea and desserts, and sleeping by 11 PM. But I am worried that suddenly giving up all desserts is too extreme and prone to rebound, and I am afraid I won't be able to resist when socializing. Can you help me evaluate whether this plan is reasonable?

session_132.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_132.text: You're worried the plan is too strict, especially the diet part. Actually, suddenly cutting out high-sugar foods completely can indeed trigger a compensation mindset. I suggest gradual sugar reduction: for example, cut desserts in half every day for the first two weeks, replace them with sugar-free yogurt or fruit, and set one "relaxed meal" per week to handle social occasions. How do you usually track your progress?

session_132.speaker: Song Yajing
session_132.text: Gradual sugar reduction and relaxed meals sound more feasible. I haven’t decided on a tracking tool yet — I want to use an app. Also, what ratio should I use for the multigrain porridge? And if I don’t hit the target one day, how do I adjust my mindset?

session_132.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_132.text: It is recommended to use Keep or MyFitnessPal to record steps and diet; they are simple and intuitive. For the multigrain porridge, use one-third each of oats, millet, and red beans, plus a small amount of red dates for flavor. If you don't meet the target one day, don't blame yourself — just get back on track the next day. Focus on the weekly average rather than a single day. For exercise, office workers can split the 6,000 steps into two 15-minute brisk walks.

session_134.text: Today, after taking a nap at my hometown in Quanzhou, I downloaded the Tide app and did two 10-minute breathing exercises. I felt my thoughts drifting occasionally, but I could bring them back. It was my first time trying meditation. How can I focus on breathing better?

session_134.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_134.text: You're doing well. It's completely normal for your mind to wander in the early stages; every time you notice it and bring it back is itself a practice in focus. You can try focusing on the sensation of breath at the tip of your nose or the rise and fall of your abdomen. If your mind wanders, silently say 'inhale' and 'exhale' to help anchor yourself. Also, with the guided sounds from the Tide app, the times you're using now (after a nap and before bed) are also very suitable for beginners to build a habit.

session_134.speaker: Song Yajing
session_134.text: Thank you, that sounds very practical. I was recently diagnosed with breast hyperplasia and am now adjusting my mindset and lifestyle. Does meditation help with this?

session_134.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_134.text: It helps. Meditation can activate the parasympathetic nervous system, helping the body switch from a stress response to a relaxed mode. With long-term practice, it can regulate emotions and lower cortisol levels, which can somewhat relieve the emotional stress associated with breast hyperplasia. You can start with 5-10 minutes a day, gradually extend the time, and set reminders at fixed times (for example, after a nap). Sticking with it for about two weeks will make it easier to see results.

session_135.text: This afternoon I did a 15-minute breathing meditation using the Tide app in my mother's bedroom, and my hands and feet felt much more relaxed! But I got distracted midway—how can I persist with meditation?

session_135.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_135.text: I'm glad you experienced relaxation! It's completely normal for beginners to have wandering thoughts. I suggest setting aside 5 minutes each day, for example pairing it with morning stretching, to anchor the new habit to an old one. You can also try a mindset of 'accepting the present moment'—when your mind wanders, gently bring your attention back without criticizing yourself.

session_135.speaker: Song Yajing
session_135.text: This "acceptance" mindset sounds useful. But I'm busy with shop work and often get interrupted by customers. How can I make sure I stick with it every day?

session_135.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_135.text: You can try the micro-habit method: start with one minute a day and choose a fixed trigger, such as after dinner or before bed. Even if you miss a day, don't feel pressured; keep going the next day. In the long run, meditation can also help you deal with business stress. session_137.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_137.text: In his later years, Monet lived at his garden in Giverny, where he built the water lily pond with his own hands, observed the changing light and shadow every day, and painted about 250 works in the Water Lilies series, aiming to capture the effects of light and color on the same scene at different moments.

session_137.speaker: Song Yajing
session_137.text: I see! Then what exactly does the Impressionists' "capturing light and shadow" mean? I want to be able to explain it clearly when I talk to my daughter later.

session_137.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_137.text: You'd like to use a simple, easy-to-understand example to explain the Impressionist concept of light and shadow? You can think of it this way: traditional painting is as meticulous as a photograph, while Impressionism is the painter quickly recording the momentary light, shadow, and color seen by the eye—for example, Monet's “Haystacks,” which uses different tones to show changes from dawn to dusk.

session_164.text: You want to confirm whether the current plan is reasonable and find more specific ways to increase income and reduce expenses. session_164.speaker: Song Yajing
session_164.text: Yes. My husband’s project subsidy is about 2,000 yuan per month, but it’s only a six-month contract. session_164.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_164.text: Suggestions: 1) The education special fund can be upgraded to a regular fund investment plan (e.g., investing 1,000 yuan per month), with higher returns than demand deposits; 2) Contact 2-3 peers to try joint procurement, which can reduce costs by 10%-15%; 3) After the couple's salaries arrive, force saving for education funds first to avoid impulse spending; 4) If the husband's project subsidy is unstable, he can simultaneously expand online orders or take on freelance work (such as remote IT maintenance) to increase income resilience.

session_164.speaker: Song Yajing
session_164.text: I have absolutely no experience with systematic fund investing and I'm afraid of losing money. Joint procurement is worth a try. Are there any other stable ways to increase income? For example, education subsidies?

session_164.text: Understand the safety concerns. You could first choose a pure bond fund or an education annuity insurance, with an annualized return of 3%-4% and principal protection. session_167.speaker: Song Yajing
session_167.text: Today I consulted a bank manager about critical illness insurance and women's disease insurance, but the details are still unclear. Could you help me sort out the core differences between these two types of insurance, their coverage, and important considerations when purchasing them?

session_167.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_167.text: Critical illness insurance covers all agreed critical illnesses (e.g., cancer, myocardial infarction) and pays a lump-sum benefit upon diagnosis; women’s disease insurance, on the other hand, targets diseases with high incidence in women such as breast cancer and cervical cancer, and may include a one-time payment and medical reimbursement. The key is to look at the list of covered diseases, the claim conditions (payment upon diagnosis vs. reimbursement), and how the payment period (20 years vs. 30 years) affects the premium. Have you had any recent check-up records? Health disclosure will affect the underwriting outcome.

session_167.speaker: Song Yajing
session_167.text: My recent physical exam showed some elevated indicators, such as a thyroid nodule. I'm worried the underwriting won't pass. Also, how should I choose the coverage amount and the premium payment period to be more reasonable?

session_167.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_167.text: For thyroid nodules, the policy may need to exclude coverage or charge an additional premium, so it is recommended to disclose truthfully. The sum insured should ideally cover 3-5 times annual income (e.g., 300,000–500,000 yuan). Choosing a 30-year payment period can reduce the annual premium burden, but the total premium is slightly higher; a 20-year payment period has a lower total premium but a higher monthly premium. Given the family's annual income, keeping the annual premium within 10% is more reasonable. When you talk to the manager tomorrow, focus on asking about the specific definitions of these terms and the scope of exclusions.

session_167.speaker: Song Yajing
session_167.text: I tried making French macarons three times and failed all three: the first time, the meringue was under-whipped and the shells were hollow; the second time, the oven temperature was too high and they cracked; the third time, feet appeared after the shells rested, but they collapsed. Can you systematically analyze the causes and give me some precise advice?

session_167.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_167.text: Based on your description: the hollow center the first time was mostly due to soft peaks; beat until stiff peaks form with firm little tips. The cracking the second time may have been caused by the upper oven temperature being too high; it is recommended to calibrate with an oven thermometer and keep the actual temperature at 140-150°C. The collapse the third time is commonly caused by insufficient drying time or deflated meringue; it is recommended to let it dry for 30-40 minutes until the surface is no longer sticky, and when folding, use the J technique gently no more than 40 times. Next time, record the meringue state and the actual oven temperature so you can quickly locate the problem.

session_167.speaker: Song Yajing
session_167.text: You mentioned the drying time for the skin; my home is very humid, so does it need longer? Also, is there a specific method for managing almond flour humidity?

session_167.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_167.text: When humidity is high, extend the drying time to 50-60 minutes, or use an oven at 40°C to dry for 10 minutes as a supplement. It is recommended to mix almond flour with powdered sugar and sift twice, and microwave on medium heat for 30 seconds before baking to remove excess oil and moisture, which can significantly improve the success rate. You can also diagnose from photos of failed batches: uneven feet are mostly caused by overmixing, and a rough surface may be because the almond flour particles are not fine enough.

session_171.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_171.text: Plan A is a term critical illness policy covering until age 70; a sum insured of 500,000 yuan is reasonable for the family's main earner. I suggest choosing a 30-year payment period to reduce annual pressure, and adding a waiver of premium for the policyholder in case of accidents. Plan B, a rider for female-specific diseases, offers good value for money, covering mild conditions with high incidence in women such as carcinoma in situ, and it does not conflict with the critical illness insurance. The total annual premium is 9,100 yuan, accounting for 3% of family income, so the budget is reasonable. For the health declaration, attention should be paid to pre-existing conditions such as nodules.

For online enrollment, be sure to provide truthful health disclosures; report any abnormal checkup findings or hospitalization history. The overall plan is reasonable, and I recommend prioritizing Plan A for Aqiang.

session_176.speaker: Song Yajing
session_176.text: Aunt Zhang shared the flaky-crust secret of Minnan pies today: use lard to replace part of the butter and add a drop of white vinegar. Could you tell me in detail the ratios of lard, butter, and white vinegar, and the key steps?

session_176.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_176.text: Classic Southern Fujian flaky pastry recipe: 250g all-purpose flour, 80g lard, 20g butter (softened at room temperature), 5ml white vinegar, about 60ml ice water. Mix the lard and butter into the flour until crumbly, add the white vinegar and ice water, and quickly knead into a dough. Rest for 30 minutes. The white vinegar increases crispness and prevents oxidation. Recommended fillings are mung bean paste or taro paste. After wrapping, brush with egg wash and bake in a 180°C oven for 25 minutes.

session_176.speaker: Song Yajing
session_176.text: The proportions are clear. But if I add too much white vinegar, will it be sour? Also, the temperature control was okay when I baked cookies today, but the pastry cracks easily. Are there any ways to prevent that?

session_176.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_176.text: 5 ml of white vinegar is a very small amount; after baking, the acetic acid evaporates and won't leave a sour taste, so don't worry. Cracks in the pastry are usually caused by dough that is too dry or insufficient resting. Use ice water when handling, and keep the dough softer rather than firmer; rest for at least 30 minutes, and pinch the opening tightly when wrapping the filling. If the room is dry, cover with a damp cloth. Also, poking small holes with a fork before baking to let steam escape can prevent cracking.

session_181.text: I plan to make macarons for the second time. The first time failed (cracked shells, no feet), but I turned the failed batch into community content. This time I want to improve systematically. What are some common causes of failure and practical tips?

session_181.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_181.text: Common causes: meringue under-whipped or over-whipped, batter deflation from overmixing (judged by the falling-flag consistency), skin-drying time not matching ambient humidity (reference humidity 40-60%, dry until it no longer sticks to the hand), temperature too high (recommend preheating at 160°C, then lowering to 140°C and baking for 14-16 minutes). Recommended home recipe: almond flour to powdered sugar ratio 1:1.8; whip room-temperature egg whites, adding sugar in three batches, until stiff peaks form; fold about 40 times until the batter forms a ribbon. It is recommended to test in small batches first; even if it fails, it can be turned into a community interaction topic again—your last experience was very smart.

Keep an experimental mindset—every failure is content material that boosts authenticity for your followers; you already verified this in June. It is recommended to do 5 test bakes first, then adjust and mass-produce.

session_185.text: Hello, my father has just been fitted with a new hearing aid, but the sound of electric bike horns downstairs at home feels harsh to him, while it is very clear in quiet environments. session_185.speaker: Song Yajing's Assistant
session_185.text: Your father's situation is likely caused by the hearing aid's compression function or gain settings not being optimized in noisy environments, resulting in sudden high-pitched sounds being over-amplified. I suggest taking him to a professional hearing aid fitting center as soon as possible for adjustment, especially during the adaptation period when parameters need to be adjusted based on his feedback. Would you like me to recommend a local hearing center in Xiamen?

session_185.speaker: Song Yajing
session_185.text: Yes, my father and I just moved to Xiamen to live together, and we're not familiar with the area yet. Please recommend a nearby hearing center. Also, does fitting usually require an appointment? About how much does it cost?

session_185.text: Xiamen has several chain hearing aid fitting centers, such as Haizhisheng and Shengwang Hearing, both of which offer free adjustment services (usually included in the purchase price). It is recommended to call ahead to make an appointment and bring the hearing aids, warranty card, and your father. Some stores may charge a registration fee (about 20–50 yuan); medical insurance generally does not reimburse adjustment fees, but you can ask. Would you like me to recommend specific stores closer to your home?

Please arrange an exchange; as usual, please have your side cover the shipping cost. Also, please send me an electronic catalog of the next batch of plus-size women's clothing so I can select styles in advance.” It is recommended to send it tomorrow morning and set a reminder to follow up on the reply.

session_185.text: According to general information, the Xiamen Ferry Terminal (Dongdu) runs every 20 minutes during the day, with the first ferry at about 7:00. Sunday Mass at the Gulangyu Catholic Church (located near the Union Church) is usually at 8:30 a.m. and 10:00 a.m., and it is recommended to arrive 30 minutes early. session_185.text: Thank you! What specific preferential policies are there for the elderly and children? Also, where exactly is the Catholic Church located, and is it far from the ferry terminal?
