session_351.speaker: Ma Xiulan
session_351.text: Tomorrow is the winter solstice. I plan to make dumplings with two kinds of filling: chive and pork, and radish and pork. But I'm worried the radish filling will have a spicy taste, and the chive filling easily releases water. How should I handle this?

session_351.speaker: Ma Xiulan's Assistant
session_351.text: Do you need techniques for removing the fishy smell and preventing excess moisture from the two fillings, as well as a time plan for overall preparation?

session_351.speaker: Ma Xiulan
session_351.text: Yes, and also tips for kneading dough and boiling dumplings without breaking, and tomorrow morning I still need to pick up the kids and welcome my husband. How should I arrange the time?

session_351.speaker: Ma Xiulan's Assistant
session_351.text: The radish filling should be blanched first, then squeezed dry, with minced ginger added to remove the spiciness. For the chive filling, chop it finely, mix with oil first, then season with salt to prevent water from seeping out. For the dough, add a little salt and egg white. When boiling the dumplings, add cold water three times. My suggestion: start making the dough and filling at 6:30 tomorrow morning, let the filling rest and absorb flavor before picking up the children at 8:30. After bringing them back, the whole family can wrap dumplings together, and your husband will be back at noon just in time to cook them.

session_351.speaker: Ma Xiulan's Assistant

session_352.speaker: Ma Xiulan's Assistant
session_352.text: Congratulations! It is indeed rare for sprouts to emerge from frozen soil in winter, which shows that your rose variety is highly cold-resistant. The new shoots may come from dormant buds deep in the soil. However, protection is needed: it is recommended to immediately cover them with a 5-10 cm layer of dry grass or non-woven fabric to protect against wind and retain moisture during the day, and prevent freezing at night.

session_352.text: Does it still need watering and fertilizing? Should we prune it a bit?

session_352.speaker: Ma Xiulan's Assistant
session_352.text: Winter sprouts do not need watering or fertilizing; avoid stimulating growth. Do not prune for now; wait until next spring when new leaves appear, then cut off the frost-damaged branches. After December, keep the mulch dry, and the roses will adjust and go dormant on their own.

session_356.speaker: Ma Xiulan
session_356.text: Dr. Wang, I practiced Baduanjin on the balcony this morning and deliberately slowed down my waist and abdomen movements. It felt a bit looser. But during the day, wrapping dumplings, picking vegetables, and kneading dough made my waist sore and swollen again. On top of that, I sat for a long time embroidering over the past few days, so I'm worried the old injury might relapse. Could you recommend a few simple stretching exercises? Preferably ones I can do in spare moments in the living room or kitchen.

session_356.speaker: Ma Xiulan's Assistant
session_356.text: The soreness you describe is muscle fatigue, and there is no indication of injury for now. I recommend three moves: Cat-Cow (kneeling, inhale as you arch your back, exhale as you round it), Child’s Pose (kneel, sit back, and lean forward with your forehead on the floor), and a spinal twist (lie on your back, bend your knees, and sway side to side). Hold each for 15 seconds, one set in the morning and one in the afternoon. Also, place a small stool under your feet when washing dishes, and switch to a long-handled mop for mopping to reduce the strain of bending.

session_356.speaker: Ma Xiulan
session_356.text: I've done Cat-Cow pose before, but I'm not sure whether my form is correct. Do you have more detailed diagrams or verbal cues? Also, it hurts a little when I do the waist twist. Is that normal?

session_356.speaker: Ma Xiulan's Assistant
session_356.text: Cat-Cow mnemonic: Inhale, lift your head and arch your lower back down; exhale, lower your head and round your back. Move slowly. I'll send you an animated image for reference. If you feel sharp pain during waist twisting, stop immediately. If it's just soreness or a dull ache, that's normal, and you can reduce the range. It is recommended to use a foam roller to roll out the back muscles together with this, which is safer.

Your craftsmanship is solid, and you can definitely win this order. Keep it up!

session_359.speaker: Ma Xiulan
session_359.text: I sorted through a year's worth of receipts and found that household expenses are very scattered. I'd like to ask if there is a simple bookkeeping method that can help me see where I can save money.

session_359.speaker: Ma Xiulan's Assistant
session_359.text: Use an app to track expenses, such as Suishouji; just split them into broad categories: food, daily necessities, education, medical, etc. Spend 10 minutes each week recording, and look at the overall account at the end of the month. To save money, you can start with groceries and daily necessities by comparing prices or looking at discounts. And you can force yourself to save 50 yuan each month as a travel or education fund.

session_359.speaker: Ma Xiulan
session_359.text: I'm not well educated, and I'm afraid I won't be able to use mobile apps well. Is there a paper template? Also, my child has no sense of money management. How can I teach him to be thrifty?

session_359.speaker: Ma Xiulan's Assistant
session_359.text: You can hand-draw a table: date, item, amount, category. Summarize every week. As for the child, let him join in keeping the accounts—for example, give him a fixed monthly allowance and let him allocate it himself; whatever is left over is his. This can cultivate the habit of being frugal.

session_359.speaker: Ma Xiulan
session_359.text: Can you help me check the specific requirements of that handmade embroidery sample job that Sister Zheng posted in the group? For example, the pattern, quantity, and price.

session_359.speaker: Ma Xiulan's Assistant
session_359.text: I checked the records. The embroidery sample is a traditional Chinese zodiac pattern, size required 15cm×15cm, first batch 20 pieces, unit price 20 yuan, materials provided by Sister Zheng. You can deliver the first batch within 1 week.

session_359.speaker: Ma Xiulan
session_359.text: 20 pieces in one week? I also have to take care of the household during the day, so I'm not sure I can finish in time. Tonight I just sewed a zodiac coin purse. Do you think I'm fast enough?

session_359.speaker: Ma Xiulan's Assistant
session_359.text: Your stitches are dense and your craftsmanship is good. I suggest you take 5 pieces to test the waters first, squeezing in 2 hours a day; you can finish in about 4 days. This way you can test the time without neglecting your family.

session_359.speaker: Ma Xiulan
session_359.text: Tonight I video-called my younger sister. She said she would bring the kids back for a few days around the twentieth of the twelfth lunar month. We plan to go to Binjiang Road to buy new clothes for the children, but I'm worried about accommodation and budget. Do you have any suggestions?

session_359.speaker: Ma Xiulan's Assistant
session_359.text: You're mainly concerned about your sister's family accommodation arrangements and shopping budget control, right? In addition, you're also thinking about transportation because you'll be bringing three children?

session_359.speaker: Ma Xiulan
session_359.text: Yes, we can stay at my home or my parents' home, but I'm not sure which is more convenient. For shopping, I'd like to find places with good value for money and not go over budget. Also, with the three kids going out together, what's the best way to get around?

session_359.speaker: Ma Xiulan's Assistant
session_359.text: Suggest that the younger sister stay at the parents' home, which is spacious and convenient for care; for shopping, prioritize the Binjiang Road business district, with Quanyechang and Isetan as key stops, at moderate prices; for travel, suggest taking a taxi or renting a seven-seat car to avoid crowded buses. Make a shopping list in advance to control spending.

session_359.speaker: Ma Xiulan
session_359.text: Yeah, my parents' house is indeed spacious, and taking a taxi saves worry. So which day works? Do we need to prepare beds and food in advance?

session_359.speaker: Ma Xiulan's Assistant
session_359.text: Recommend choosing a day between the 23rd and 27th of the twelfth lunar month, avoiding weekend crowds. You need to prepare bedding and simple New Year snacks in advance, since you'll be staying for several days. Before going, you can check the Spring Festival business hours of the shopping malls on Binjiang Road.

session_359.speaker: Ma Xiulan
session_359.text: Today was a busy day. I'm tired but feel very fulfilled. I got up early to make stuffed pancakes for my family, and when I picked up the child, the teacher even praised me. It feels good even in ordinary days.

session_359.speaker: Ma Xiulan's Assistant
session_359.text: It sounds like you had a fulfilling day today. That sense of satisfaction from being needed and appreciated by your family is especially precious. You want to share this warmth and also hope to be understood, right?

session_359.speaker: Ma Xiulan
session_359.text: Hmm, sometimes I do think about whether all this hard work is worth it, especially when money is a little tight, but seeing the family happy makes everything worth it. Oh, by the way, my younger sister is about to come back, and I'm really looking forward to it.

session_359.speaker: Ma Xiulan's Assistant
session_359.text: Your family has surely seen all your efforts, and this warmth is the best reward. Take the financial pressure slowly; your younger sister coming home for a reunion is even better. You've been busy all day, so if your back and legs ache, remember to soak your feet and get some good rest.

session_359.speaker: Ma Xiulan
session_359.text: Thank you for saying that, it warms my heart. When my sister comes back, we can still discuss how to spend the Spring Festival together. Just thinking about it gives me something to look forward to.

session_359.speaker: Ma Xiulan's Assistant
session_359.text: A family working together is the greatest motivation. Every detail of what you did today shows love and responsibility, and deserves to be cherished. Rest early; tomorrow will be another beautiful day.

session_360.speaker: Ma Xiulan
session_360.text: I'm Ma Xiulan. With three kids in school, saving for education feels too hard. Monthly income is only 3600 yuan, expenses are about 3417, and nothing is left. Any good ways to build up more education savings?

session_360.speaker: Ma Xiulan's Assistant
session_360.text: It sounds like you need to build education funds for your three children without increasing your income, by optimizing expenses and using low-barrier savings tools. Your main concern right now is that daily spending takes up room that could go to savings, is that right?

session_360.speaker: Ma Xiulan
session_360.text: Yes, miscellaneous expenses like groceries and the kids' allowance are over budget every month. Also, the eldest son's education savings account is still 1,500 yuan short of the 5,000 target, and we need to start saving for the other two kids as well.

session_360.speaker: Ma Xiulan's Assistant
session_360.text: I suggest you try the forced small-change savings method: every day, put the leftover change from grocery shopping (for example, 5 yuan or 10 yuan) into a dedicated piggy bank, saving at least 150 yuan more each month. At the same time, do a concentrated purchase of vegetables and fruits on weekends, which saves about 20% compared with buying a little every day. This way, you can accumulate nearly 2,000 yuan over the year, and use it first to make up the shortfall in your eldest son's account.

session_360.speaker: Ma Xiulan
session_360.text: I sat for six hours today going over the accounts. My neck is stiff and my lower back is sore. Is there any way to relieve this that doesn't take time or money?

session_360.speaker: Ma Xiulan's Assistant
session_360.text: You need simple stretches and posture adjustment methods for lower back and neck soreness caused by prolonged desk work. It is recommended to get up and move every 30 minutes, do neck lateral flexion and the cat-cow pose, and add mugwort to foot-soaking water to promote circulation.

session_360.speaker: Ma Xiulan
session_360.text: Is adding mugwort to a foot soak really effective? What's the exact method?

session_360.speaker: Ma Xiulan's Assistant
session_360.text: Mugwort has the effects of warming the meridians and dispelling cold, suitable for foot soaking to relieve fatigue. Take a small handful of dried mugwort, boil it in water, and add it to the footbath water. Keep the water temperature around 40 degrees, soak for 15-20 minutes, and the water level should cover the ankles.

session_362.speaker: Ma Xiulan
session_362.text: I have 2,200 yuan on hand and want to deposit it as a one-year fixed deposit tomorrow, as emergency money and a children's education fund. There are the Rural Commercial Bank, Postal Savings Bank, and Agricultural Bank of China nearby. Which one has the highest interest rate? What documents do I need to bring?

session_362.speaker: Ma Xiulan's Assistant
session_362.text: Currently, the one-year interest rate at Postal Savings Bank is about 1.75%; rural commercial banks may be slightly higher, for example 1.9%. The exact rate depends on the branch. Bring your own and your husband's ID cards and household registration book; if it's a joint deposit, bring the marriage certificate as well. The process is simple: take a number when you enter, fill out a deposit slip, write the amount as 2,200 yuan, choose 'one-year fixed deposit,' and handle it at the counter. Early withdrawal earns demand deposit interest, so I suggest choosing automatic renewal.

session_362.speaker: Ma Xiulan
session_362.text: Then can I just deposit it under my own name? No need for joint name with my husband, right? Also, is there a minimum limit for 2,200 yuan?

session_362.speaker: Ma Xiulan's Assistant
session_362.text: You can put it only in your own name, no need for a joint account. 2,200 yuan is far above the 50-yuan minimum deposit, so no problem. I suggest bringing cash and your ID, and go to the rural commercial bank tomorrow to compare interest rates and then open it directly. Remember to tell the teller "automatic rollover" so that after maturity the principal and interest will be automatically renewed.

session_362.speaker: Ma Xiulan
session_362.text: I would like to learn about the essential household medicine list and precautions for children's medication. I have three children, aged 13, 10, and 6.

session_362.speaker: Ma Xiulan's Assistant
session_362.text: You'd like suggestions for stocking a family medicine cabinet for children of different ages, as well as guidance on the safe use of medicine for common childhood conditions such as fever and cough, right?

session_362.speaker: Ma Xiulan
session_362.text: Yes, especially the specifications and usage of fever suppositories when a 6-year-old daughter has a fever. I'm not sure which one to buy.

session_362.speaker: Ma Xiulan's Assistant
session_362.text: Children's antipyretic suppositories (acetaminophen) should be selected by weight: a 6-year-old weighing about 20 kg should use the 100 mg strength, once every 4 to 6 hours, no more than 4 times in 24 hours. Recommended medicine cabinet contents: antipyretics, oral rehydration salts, band-aids, iodophor, and medical gauze. Store medicines in a cool, dry place and check the expiration dates regularly.

session_362.speaker: Ma Xiulan
